title: Implement the Sign-in with Google
author: mathrmartins
milestone: [V1] Content Management System - Proof of Concept - Courses
acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): ## User Story: As a user who prefers convenient authentication methods, I want to be able to sign in seamlessly with my Google account. ## Description: As a user, I want the option to sign in or sign up using my Google account to streamline the authentication process. This requires implementing the Google OAuth Provider within the NextAuth.js configuration. Additionally, I expect to find a "Sign in with Google" button on the sign-in page. Clicking this button should initiate the sign-in process via Next.js Server Action. During the sign-in process, upon clicking the "Sign in with Google" button, I expect to be redirected to the Google authentication page to enter my credentials. After completing the sign-in process, I should be redirected back to the application and logged in. Moreover, I anticipate that the sign-in process with Google will seamlessly integrate with the API backend built on Nest.js, ensuring a smooth user experience. Additionally, I would appreciate the option to enable One Tap Sign-in with Google for even faster authentication. In summary, this user story aims to provide users with the convenience of signing in and signing up using their Google accounts while ensuring a seamless and efficient authentication process. ## Requirements: - [x] Implement the Google Provider in the NextAuth.js configuration. - [x] Implement the Next.js Server Action to initiate the Sign-in with Google process. - [x] Manage the Sign-in with Google process in the NextAuth.js sign-in callback. - [x] Integrate the Sign-in with Google with the backend API (Nest.js). - [x] #63 - [x] Create the "Sign in with Google" button with its variations as specified in the [Sign in with Google Branding Guidelines](https://developers.google.com/identity/branding-guidelines). - [x] Add the "Sign in with Google" button on the sign-in page. - [x] Add the "Sign up with Google" button on the sign-in page.

# API Versioning Options Configuration

**GitHub Issue Template: Feature Request**

## User Story
As a software architect, I want to configure API versioning strategies through a structured options pattern, so that I can implement multiple versioning approaches (URL-based, header-based, query parameter-based) while maintaining backward compatibility and clear API evolution paths.

## Problem Statement
Current API systems lack a unified configuration approach for versioning strategies. Different versioning methods (URL segments, HTTP headers, query parameters) require different implementations, making it difficult to standardize versioning across the entire API surface. There's no centralized way to configure versioning behavior, default versions, or migration policies.

## Proposed Solution
Implement `ApiVersioningOptions` that provides a structured configuration for API versioning with support for multiple strategies and unified version management.

### Core Components:
- **Versioning Strategy Configuration**: Support for URL, header, and query parameter versioning
- **Default Version Management**: Configure default API versions and fallback behavior
- **Version Format Specification**: Support for semantic versioning, date-based versioning, or custom formats
- **Deprecation Policies**: Configure how deprecated versions are handled
- **Backward Compatibility**: Rules for maintaining compatibility across versions

### Technical Implementation:
```csharp
public class ApiVersioningOptions
{
    public VersioningStrategy Strategy { get; set; }
    public string DefaultVersion { get; set; }
    public VersionFormat Format { get; set; }
    public DeprecationPolicy DeprecationPolicy { get; set; }
    public BackwardCompatibilityRules CompatibilityRules { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, VersionConfiguration> VersionConfigurations { get; set; }
}
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Support for URL-based versioning (e.g., `/api/v1/users`, `/api/v2/users`)
- [ ] Support for header-based versioning (e.g., `X-API-Version: 1.0`)
- [ ] Support for query parameter versioning (e.g., `?version=1.0`)
- [ ] Configure default version when no version is specified
- [ ] Support for semantic versioning (Major.Minor.Patch)
- [ ] Support for date-based versioning (YYYY-MM-DD)
- [ ] Configure deprecation warnings and sunset dates
- [ ] Automatic routing to appropriate version handlers
- [ ] Version compatibility matrix configuration
- [ ] Integration with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation
- [ ] Validation of version format consistency
- [ ] Support for pre-release versions (alpha, beta, rc)

## Technical Requirements
- Integration with ASP.NET Core API versioning middleware
- Support for multiple concurrent versions
- Thread-safe configuration loading
- Performance-optimized version resolution
- Comprehensive logging of version usage
- Metrics collection for version adoption tracking

## Dependencies
- ASP.NET Core framework
- API versioning middleware packages
- Configuration system integration
- OpenAPI documentation generation
- Logging and metrics infrastructure

## Definition of Done
- [ ] `ApiVersioningOptions` class implemented with full configuration support
- [ ] Integration with ASP.NET Core dependency injection
- [ ] Support for all three versioning strategies (URL, header, query)
- [ ] Default version configuration and fallback behavior
- [ ] Deprecation policy implementation with warnings
- [ ] Version format validation and consistency checks
- [ ] OpenAPI integration for multi-version documentation
- [ ] Comprehensive unit tests covering all versioning scenarios
- [ ] Integration tests with sample API endpoints
- [ ] Performance tests for version resolution overhead
- [ ] Documentation with configuration examples and best practices
- [ ] Migration guide for existing APIs

# OpenAPI Options Configuration

## User Story
As a software architect, I want to configure OpenAPI/Swagger documentation through a structured options pattern, so that I can generate comprehensive API documentation with security schemes, custom metadata, and standardized formatting across all API endpoints.

## Problem Statement
Current OpenAPI configurations are scattered across multiple files and lack standardization. Security scheme definitions, API metadata, documentation generation options, and custom extensions require manual configuration in different locations, making it difficult to maintain consistent API documentation standards across the entire application.

## Proposed Solution
Implement `OpenApiOptions` that provides a centralized configuration for OpenAPI/Swagger documentation with comprehensive security schemes, metadata management, and generation options.

- **Document Metadata Configuration**: Title, description, version, contact information
- **Security Schemes Definition**: JWT, OAuth2, API Keys, Basic Auth configurations
- **Server Configuration**: Multiple environment URLs and descriptions
- **Custom Schema Generation**: Data annotations, example values, custom serialization
- **UI Customization**: Swagger UI theming and behavior options
- **Extension Points**: Custom OpenAPI extensions and documentation enrichment

```csharp
public class OpenApiOptions
{
    public OpenApiDocumentInfo DocumentInfo { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, OpenApiSecurityScheme> SecuritySchemes { get; set; }
    public List<OpenApiServer> Servers { get; set; }
    public SchemaGenerationOptions SchemaOptions { get; set; }
    public SwaggerUIOptions UIOptions { get; set; }
    public Dictionary<string, object> Extensions { get; set; }
```

title: Billing Webhook Processing & Event Handling
author: mathrmartins
acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): # Billing Webhook Processing & Event Handling ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS platform**, I want to **reliably process webhooks from payment gateways and billing providers** so that I can **keep subscription and payment states synchronized, handle asynchronous events, and ensure data consistency**. ## Problem Statement Payment gateways and billing providers send critical events via webhooks: - Payment succeeded/failed notifications - Subscription state changes (trial ended, renewed, canceled) - Dispute notifications (chargeback initiated/resolved) - Invoice finalized/paid notifications - Payment method updates (card expiration, update via Account Updater) Without proper webhook handling: - Subscription states become out of sync - Failed payments aren't retried promptly - Customer disputes are missed - Manual reconciliation required - Customer experience suffers (access not granted despite payment) ## Proposed Solution Implement a robust webhook processing system with verification, idempotency, and reliable event handling: ### WebhookEvent Entity ```csharp public class WebhookEvent : EntityBase<Guid> { // Source public string Provider { get; set; } // "stripe", "paypal", etc. public string EventId { get; set; } // Gateway's event ID public string EventType { get; set; } // "payment.succeeded", "invoice.paid" // Payload public string RawPayload { get; set; } // Original JSON public DateTime ReceivedAt { get; set; } // Processing public WebhookStatus Status { get; set; } public int ProcessingAttempts { get; set; } public DateTime? ProcessedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? LastAttemptAt { get; set; } public DateTime? NextRetryAt { get; set; } // Verification public string Signature { get; set; } public bool SignatureVerified { get; set; } public DateTime? VerifiedAt { get; set; } // Results public string? ProcessingError { get; set; } public Dictionary<string, string>? ProcessingResult { get; set; } // Related Entities public Guid? TenantId { get; set; } public Guid? PaymentId { get; set; } public Guid? SubscriptionId { get; set; } public Guid? InvoiceId { get; set; } // Metadata public string IpAddress { get; set; } public string UserAgent { get; set; } public Dictionary<string, string> Headers { get; set; } } public enum WebhookStatus { Received, Verified, Processing, Processed, Failed, Ignored } ``` ### Webhook Handler Interface ```csharp public interface IWebhookHandler { string Provider { get; } Task<WebhookVerificationResult> VerifySignatureAsync( string payload, IDictionary<string, string> headers, string secret); Task<WebhookProcessingResult> ProcessEventAsync( WebhookEvent webhookEvent); bool CanHandle(string eventType); } public abstract class WebhookHandlerBase : IWebhookHandler { public abstract string Provider { get; } public abstract Task<WebhookVerificationResult> VerifySignatureAsync( string payload, IDictionary<string, string> headers, string secret); public abstract bool CanHandle(string eventType); public async Task<WebhookProcessingResult> ProcessEventAsync( WebhookEvent webhookEvent) { // Idempotency check if (await IsAlreadyProcessedAsync(webhookEvent.EventId)) return WebhookProcessingResult.AlreadyProcessed(); // Parse and route to specific handler var eventType = ParseEventType(webhookEvent.RawPayload); return eventType switch { "payment.succeeded" => await HandlePaymentSucceededAsync(webhookEvent), "payment.failed" => await HandlePaymentFailedAsync(webhookEvent), "subscription.updated" => await HandleSubscriptionUpdatedAsync(webhookEvent), "subscription.deleted" => await HandleSubscriptionDeletedAsync(webhookEvent), "invoice.paid" => await HandleInvoicePaidAsync(webhookEvent), "invoice.payment_failed" => await HandleInvoicePaymentFailedAsync(webhookEvent), "customer.subscription.trial_will_end" => await HandleTrialWillEndAsync(webhookEvent), "charge.dispute.created" => await HandleDisputeCreatedAsync(webhookEvent), _ => WebhookProcessingResult.Ignored($"Unhandled event type: {eventType}") }; } protected abstract Task<WebhookProcessingResult> HandlePaymentSucceededAsync(WebhookEvent webhookEvent); protected abstract Task<WebhookProcessingResult> HandlePaymentFailedAsync(WebhookEvent webhookEvent); // ... other handlers } ``` ### Stripe Webhook Handler ```csharp public class StripeWebhookHandler : WebhookHandlerBase { private readonly IPaymentService _paymentService; private readonly ISubscriptionService _subscriptionService; private readonly IInvoiceService _invoiceService; public override string Provider => "stripe"; public override async Task<WebhookVerificationResult> VerifySignatureAsync( string payload, IDictionary<string, string> headers, string secret) { try { var signature = headers["Stripe-Signature"]; var stripeEvent = EventUtility.ConstructEvent( payload, signature, secret); return WebhookVerificationResult.Success(stripeEvent.Id); } catch (StripeException ex) { return WebhookVerificationResult.Failed(ex.Message); } } protected override async Task<WebhookProcessingResult> HandlePaymentSucceededAsync( WebhookEvent webhookEvent) { var stripeEvent = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Event>(webhookEvent.RawPayload); var paymentIntent = stripeEvent.Data.Object as PaymentIntent; // Update payment status var payment = await _paymentService.GetByGatewayTransactionIdAsync(paymentIntent.Id); if (payment == null) return WebhookProcessingResult.Failed("Payment not found"); await _paymentService.MarkAsSucceededAsync( payment.Id, paymentIntent.Charges.Data[0].Id); // Update subscription if applicable if (payment.SubscriptionId.HasValue) { await _subscriptionService.ActivateAsync(payment.SubscriptionId.Value); } // Mark invoice as paid if (payment.InvoiceId.HasValue) { await _invoiceService.MarkAsPaidAsync( payment.InvoiceId.Value, payment.Id); } return WebhookProcessingResult.Success(new Dictionary<string, string> { ["PaymentId"] = payment.Id.ToString(), ["Status"] = "Succeeded" }); } protected override async Task<WebhookProcessingResult> HandleSubscriptionUpdatedAsync( WebhookEvent webhookEvent) { var stripeEvent = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<Event>(webhookEvent.RawPayload); var subscription = stripeEvent.Data.Object as Subscription; var localSub = await _subscriptionService .GetByGatewaySubscriptionIdAsync(subscription.Id); if (localSub == null) return WebhookProcessingResult.Failed("Subscription not found"); // Sync status await _subscriptionService.SyncStatusFromGatewayAsync( localSub.Id, subscription.Status, subscription.CurrentPeriodEnd); return WebhookProcessingResult.Success(); } } ``` ### Webhook Processing Service ```csharp public class WebhookProcessingService : BackgroundService { protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken) { while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested) { await ProcessPendingWebhooksAsync(); await Task.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30), stoppingToken); } } private async Task ProcessPendingWebhooksAsync() { var pendingWebhooks = await _webhookRepo .GetPendingForProcessingAsync(limit: 50); foreach (var webhook in pendingWebhooks) { await ProcessWebhookAsync(webhook); } } private async Task ProcessWebhookAsync(WebhookEvent webhook) { try { webhook.Status = WebhookStatus.Processing; webhook.LastAttemptAt = DateTime.UtcNow; webhook.ProcessingAttempts++; await _webhookRepo.UpdateAsync(webhook); var handler = _handlers.FirstOrDefault(h => h.Provider == webhook.Provider && h.CanHandle(webhook.EventType)); if (handler == null) { webhook.Status = WebhookStatus.Ignored; webhook.ProcessingError = "No handler found"; await _webhookRepo.UpdateAsync(webhook); return; } var result = await handler.ProcessEventAsync(webhook); if (result.IsSuccess) { webhook.Status = WebhookStatus.Processed; webhook.ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow; webhook.ProcessingResult = result.Data; } else { webhook.Status = WebhookStatus.Failed; webhook.ProcessingError = result.Error; webhook.NextRetryAt = CalculateNextRetry(webhook.ProcessingAttempts); } await _webhookRepo.UpdateAsync(webhook); } catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Webhook processing failed for {WebhookId}", webhook.Id); webhook.Status = WebhookStatus.Failed; webhook.ProcessingError = ex.Message; webhook.NextRetryAt = CalculateNextRetry(webhook.ProcessingAttempts); await _webhookRepo.UpdateAsync(webhook); } } private DateTime CalculateNextRetry(int attempts) { // Exponential backoff: 1min, 5min, 15min, 1hr, 6hr var delays = new[] { 1, 5, 15, 60, 360 }; var delayMinutes = attempts < delays.Length ? delays[attempts] : 1440; acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **payment operations manager**, I want to **automatically detect and prevent fraudulent transactions and subscription abuse** so that **we minimize chargebacks, reduce financial losses, and protect legitimate customers from fraud**. ## Problem Statement SaaS platforms face significant fraud risks: - **Payment Fraud:** Stolen credit cards used for subscriptions - **Friendly Fraud:** Legitimate customers filing false chargebacks - **Card Testing:** Bots testing stolen card numbers with small transactions - **Subscription Abuse:** Creating trial accounts repeatedly with different emails - **Account Takeover:** Stolen credentials used to change payment methods - **Refund Abuse:** Exploiting refund policies with fraudulent claims Without fraud detection: - **Financial Loss:** 1-3% of revenue lost to chargebacks and fraud - **Chargeback Fees:** $15-$100 per chargeback dispute - **Payment Processor Risk:** High chargeback rates (>1%) trigger account review or termination - **Reputation Damage:** Fraud victims lose trust in platform security - **Manual Review Burden:** Staff overwhelmed reviewing suspicious transactions - **Legitimate Customer Friction:** No way to differentiate real vs fraudulent users Industry data shows: - Average e-commerce fraud rate: 2.9% of transactions - 86% of chargebacks are friendly fraud (illegitimate) - Card testing attacks can try 100,000+ cards in hours - Trial abuse costs SaaS companies 5-15% of MRR ## Proposed Solution ### Fraud Score Entity ```csharp public class FraudScore { public Guid Id { get; set; } public Guid? UserId { get; set; } // Null for anonymous attempts public Guid? PaymentId { get; set; } public Guid? SubscriptionId { get; set; } public decimal Score { get; set; } // 0-100 (0 = safe, 100 = definite fraud) public FraudRiskLevel RiskLevel { get; set; } // Low, Medium, High, Critical public FraudDecision Decision { get; set; } // Allow, Review, Block public string DecisionReason { get; set; } public List<FraudSignal> Signals { get; set; } // List of detected fraud indicators public FraudAction ActionTaken { get; set; } // None, Flagged, Blocked, Refunded public DateTime ScoredAt { get; set; } public bool IsManuallyReviewed { get; set; } public string? ReviewNotes { get; set; } public Guid? ReviewedByUserId { get; set; } public DateTime? ReviewedAt { get; set; } } public enum FraudRiskLevel { Low, // Score 0-30 Medium, // Score 31-60 High, // Score 61-85 Critical // Score 86-100 } public enum FraudDecision { Allow, // Transaction allowed Review, // Flagged for manual review Block // Transaction blocked } public enum FraudAction { None, Flagged, Blocked, Refunded, AccountSuspended } ``` ### Fraud Signal Entity ```csharp public class FraudSignal { public string SignalType { get; set; } // "VelocityCheck", "IPMismatch", "CardTest", etc. public decimal Weight { get; set; } // Signal contribution to score (0-100) public string Details { get; set; } // JSON with signal-specific data public DateTime DetectedAt { get; set; } } ``` ### Fraud Rules Configuration ```csharp public class FraudRule { public Guid Id { get; set; } public string RuleName { get; set; } public FraudRuleType RuleType { get; set; } public bool IsEnabled { get; set; } public decimal BaseScore { get; set; } // Score added if rule triggers public string Configuration { get; set; } // JSON with rule-specific params public int Priority { get; set; } // Execution order public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? UpdatedAt { get; set; } } public enum FraudRuleType { VelocityCheck, // Multiple transactions in short time IPBlacklist, // Known malicious IP ranges EmailBlacklist, // Disposable email providers BINCheck, // Card BIN country vs user country DeviceFingerprintDupe, // Same device multiple accounts HighRiskCountry, // Country with high fraud rates CardTestingPattern, // Small rapid transactions BehaviorAnomaly, // Deviation from user's normal pattern AVSMismatch, // Address verification failed CVVFailure, // CVV check failed ProxyVPN, // User behind proxy/VPN AccountAge, // New account high-value purchase } ``` ### IFraudDetectionService Interface ```csharp public interface IFraudDetectionService { Task<FraudScore> ScorePaymentAsync(Guid paymentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<FraudScore> ScoreSubscriptionAsync(Guid subscriptionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<FraudScore> ScoreUserAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<bool> IsIPBlacklistedAsync(string ipAddress, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<bool> IsEmailSuspiciousAsync(string email, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<List<FraudSignal>> DetectCardTestingAsync(string ipAddress, TimeSpan window, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<decimal> CalculateVelocityScoreAsync(Guid userId, TimeSpan window, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); } ``` ### FraudDetectionService Implementation ```csharp public class FraudDetectionService : IFraudDetectionService { private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context; private readonly ILogger<FraudDetectionService> _logger; public async Task<FraudScore> ScorePaymentAsync(Guid paymentId, CancellationToken cancellationToken) { var payment = await _context.Payments .Include(p => p.User) .Include(p => p.PaymentMethod) .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.Id == paymentId, cancellationToken); if (payment == null) throw new NotFoundException($"Payment {paymentId} not found"); var signals = new List<FraudSignal>(); decimal totalScore = 0; // Rule 1: Velocity Check (multiple payments in 10 minutes) var recentPayments = await _context.Payments .Where(p => p.UserId == payment.UserId && p.CreatedAt >= DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-10)) .CountAsync(cancellationToken); if (recentPayments > 3) { var velocityScore = Math.Min((recentPayments - 3) * 15, 40); signals.Add(new FraudSignal { SignalType = "VelocityCheck", Weight = velocityScore, Details = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { PaymentCount = recentPayments, WindowMinutes = 10 }), DetectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); totalScore += velocityScore; } // Rule 2: IP Country Mismatch var userCountry = payment.User.Country; var ipCountry = await GetCountryFromIPAsync(payment.IpAddress); if (userCountry != ipCountry && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(userCountry)) { signals.Add(new FraudSignal { SignalType = "IPCountryMismatch", Weight = 20, Details = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { UserCountry = userCountry, IPCountry = ipCountry }), DetectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); totalScore += 20; } // Rule 3: Card BIN Check var cardBin = payment.PaymentMethod.CardNumber?.Substring(0, 6); var binCountry = await GetCountryFromBINAsync(cardBin); if (binCountry != userCountry && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(binCountry) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(userCountry)) { signals.Add(new FraudSignal { SignalType = "BINMismatch", Weight = 25, Details = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { CardCountry = binCountry, UserCountry = userCountry }), DetectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); totalScore += 25; } // Rule 4: Disposable Email if (IsDisposableEmail(payment.User.Email)) { signals.Add(new FraudSignal { SignalType = "DisposableEmail", Weight = 30, Details = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { Email = payment.User.Email }), DetectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); totalScore += 30; } // Rule 5: New Account + High Value var accountAgeHours = (DateTime.UtcNow - payment.User.CreatedAt).TotalHours; if (accountAgeHours < 24 && payment.Amount > 500) { signals.Add(new FraudSignal { SignalType = "NewAccountHighValue", Weight = 35, Details = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { AccountAgeHours = accountAgeHours, Amount = payment.Amount }), DetectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); totalScore += 35; } // Rule 6: Card Testing Pattern (small amount) if (payment.Amount < 5) { var smallTransactions = await _context.Payments .Where(p => p.IpAddress == payment.IpAddress && p.Amount < 5 && p.CreatedAt >= DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-30)) .CountAsync(cancellationToken); if (smallTransactions > 5) { signals.Add(new FraudSignal { SignalType = "CardTestingPattern", Weight = 50, Details = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { SmallTransactions = smallTransactions, Amount = payment.Amount }), DetectedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); totalScore += 50; } } // Cap total score at 100 totalScore = Math.Min(totalScore, 100); // Determine risk level and decision var riskLevel = totalScore switch { < 30 => FraudRiskLevel.Low, < 60 => FraudRiskLevel.Medium, < 85 => FraudRiskLevel.High, _ => FraudRiskLevel.Critical }; var decision = totalScore switch { < 60 => FraudDecision.Allow, < 85 => FraudDecision.Review, _ => FraudDecision.Block }; var fraudScore = new FraudScore { PaymentId = paymentId, UserId = payment.UserId, Score = totalScore, RiskLevel = riskLevel, Decision = decision, DecisionReason = $"{signals.Count} fraud signals detected", Signals = signals, ActionTaken = decision == FraudDecision.Block ? FraudAction.Blocked : FraudAction.None, ScoredAt = DateTime.UtcNow }; await _context.FraudScores.AddAsync(fraudScore, cancellationToken); await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken); _logger.LogWarning("Payment {PaymentId} scored {Score}/100 - Risk: {RiskLevel}, Decision: {Decision}", paymentId, totalScore, riskLevel, decision); return fraudScore; } private bool IsDisposableEmail(string email) { var disposableDomains = new[] { "mailinator.com", "guerrillamail.com", "10minutemail.com", "temp-mail.org" }; var domain = email.Split('@').LastOrDefault()?.ToLowerInvariant(); return disposableDomains.Contains(domain); } } ``` ### Commands ```csharp public record ScorePaymentCommand(Guid PaymentId) : IRequest<Result<FraudScore>>; public record ScoreSubscriptionCommand(Guid SubscriptionId) : IRequest<Result<FraudScore>>; public record BlockPaymentCommand(Guid PaymentId, string Reason) : IRequest<Result>; public record ReviewFraudCaseCommand(Guid FraudScoreId, bool IsLegitimate, string ReviewNotes) : IRequest<Result>; public record AddIPToBlacklistCommand(string IpAddress, string Reason, DateTime? ExpiryDate = null) : IRequest<Result>; public record AddEmailToBlacklistCommand(string Email, string Reason) : IRequest<Result>; public record UpdateFraudRuleCommand(Guid RuleId, bool IsEnabled, decimal BaseScore) : IRequest<Result>; ``` ### Queries ```csharp public record GetFraudScoreQuery(Guid FraudScoreId) : IRequest<Result<FraudScore>>; public record GetPaymentFraudScoreQuery(Guid PaymentId) : IRequest<Result<FraudScore>>; public record GetUserFraudHistoryQuery(Guid UserId) : IRequest<Result<List<FraudScore>>>; public record GetPendingReviewsQuery(int PageNumber, int PageSize) : IRequest<Result<PagedResult<FraudScore>>>; public record GetFraudStatisticsQuery(DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate) : IRequest<Result<FraudStatistics>>; public record GetHighRiskUsersQuery(int Limit = 100) : IRequest<Result<List<UserRiskProfile>>>; public record CheckIPBlacklistQuery(string IpAddress) : IRequest<Result<bool>>; ``` ### REST API Endpoints ```csharp // POST risk // POST /api/fraud/block/payment/{paymentId} - Block a payment manually // GET /api/fraud/scores/{id} - Get fraud score details // GET /api/fraud/pending-reviews - List cases needing manual review // POST /api/fraud/reviews/{scoreId} - Submit manual review decision // GET /api/fraud/blacklist/ip/{ipAddress} - Check if IP is blacklisted // POST /api/fraud/blacklist/ip - Add IP to blacklist // DELETE /api/fraud/blacklist/ip/{ipAddress} - Remove from blacklist // GET /api/fraud/statistics - Get fraud metrics (blocked, reviewed, rates) // GET /api/fraud/rules - List all fraud detection rules // PUT /api/fraud/rules/{ruleId} - Update fraud rule configuration ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Real-Time Fraud Scoring - [ ] Score every payment transaction before processing - [ ] Score subscription creations and changes - [ ] Complete scoring in < 200ms (non-blocking) - [ ] Support asynchronous scoring for background checks - [ ] Score = 0-100 (0 safe, 100 definite fraud) - [ PeriodStart { get; set; } public DateTime? acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS platform administrator**, I want to **offer pricing in multiple currencies with automatic foreign exchange rate synchronization** so that **international customers can view prices and pay in their local currency, improving conversion rates and user experience**. ## Problem Statement Current billing system only supports single-currency pricing (typically USD), forcing international customers to: - Calculate conversion rates manually - Pay foreign transaction fees on credit cards - Deal with confusing pricing displays - Experience price fluctuations due to FX rate changes Global SaaS platforms need: - Display prices in 150+ currencies - Automatic FX rate updates from reliable providers - Currency-specific rounding rules (JPY has no decimals, KWD has 3 decimals) - Multi-currency revenue reporting and reconciliation - Base currency for accounting with foreign currency tracking - Price override capability per market (psychological pricing like $9.99 vs €8.99) - Historical FX rate storage for audit and tax compliance - Currency switching in user accounts without data loss Without multi-currency support: - Lost sales from international customers confused by foreign currency pricing - Increased support burden explaining FX calculations - Competitive disadvantage vs platforms offering local currency - Complex manual accounting for multi-currency revenue - Risk of pricing errors during currency fluctuations ## Proposed Solution ### Currency Configuration Entity ```csharp public class CurrencyConfiguration { public Guid Id { get; set; } public string CurrencyCode { get; set; } // ISO 4217: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, etc. public string DisplayName { get; set; } // "US Dollar", "Euro" public string Symbol { get; set; } // "$", "€", "£", "¥" public int DecimalPlaces { get; set; } // 2 for most, 0 for JPY, 3 for KWD public bool IsEnabled { get; set; } public bool IsBaseCurrency { get; set; } // Accounting base (typically USD) public int DisplayOrder { get; set; } public DateTime EnabledAt { get; set; } public DateTime? DisabledAt { get; set; } } ``` ### Exchange Rate Entity ```csharp public class ExchangeRate { public Guid Id { get; set; } public string BaseCurrency { get; set; } // USD public string TargetCurrency { get; set; } // EUR public decimal Rate { get; set; } // 0.85 (1 USD = 0.85 EUR) public DateTime EffectiveDate { get; set; } public ExchangeRateSource Source { get; set; } // OpenExchangeRates, ECB, Manual public string Provider { get; set; } // API provider name public string RawResponse { get; set; } // JSON response from provider for audit public DateTime CreatedAt { get; set; } } public enum ExchangeRateSource { OpenExchangeRates, ECB, // European Central Bank Manual, FixedOverride } ``` ### Price Localization Entity ```csharp public class PriceLocalization { public Guid Id { get; set; } public Guid PlanId { get; set; } public string CurrencyCode { get; set; } public decimal LocalizedPrice { get; set; } // Override price (e.g., €8.99 instead of €8.67) public bool IsAutoCalculated { get; set; } // true = use FX rate, false = manual override public DateTime? LastCalculatedAt { get; set; } public decimal? ExchangeRateUsed { get; set; } // Rate at time of last calculation public DateTime EffectiveDate { get; set; } public DateTime? ExpiryDate { get; set; } } ``` ### IExchangeRateService Interface ```csharp public interface IExchangeRateService { Task<decimal> GetCurrentRateAsync(string baseCurrency, string targetCurrency, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<Dictionary<string, decimal>> GetAllRatesAsync(string baseCurrency, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task SyncRatesFromProviderAsync(ExchangeRateSource source, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<ExchangeRate> GetHistoricalRateAsync(string baseCurrency, string targetCurrency, DateTime date, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<decimal> ConvertAsync(decimal amount, string fromCurrency, string toCurrency, DateTime? date = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); } ``` ### OpenExchangeRatesService Implementation ```csharp public class OpenExchangeRatesService : IExchangeRateService { private readonly HttpClient _httpClient; private readonly IConfiguration _configuration; private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context; public async Task SyncRatesFromProviderAsync(ExchangeRateSource source, CancellationToken cancellationToken) { if (source != ExchangeRateSource.OpenExchangeRates) throw new InvalidOperationException($"This service only supports {ExchangeRateSource.OpenExchangeRates}"); var apiKey = _configuration["OpenExchangeRates:ApiKey"]; var response = await _httpClient.GetAsync($"https://openexchangerates.org/api/latest.json?app_id={apiKey}", cancellationToken); response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode(); var json = await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync(cancellationToken); var data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<OpenExchangeRatesResponse>(json); var baseCurrency = data.Base; // USD var effectiveDate = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeSeconds(data.Timestamp).UtcDateTime; var exchangeRates = new List<ExchangeRate>(); foreach (var (currency, rate) in data.Rates) { exchangeRates.Add(new ExchangeRate { BaseCurrency = baseCurrency, TargetCurrency = currency, Rate = rate, EffectiveDate = effectiveDate, Source = ExchangeRateSource.OpenExchangeRates, Provider = "Open Exchange Rates", RawResponse = json, CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow }); } await _context.ExchangeRates.AddRangeAsync(exchangeRates, cancellationToken); await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken); } public async Task<decimal> ConvertAsync(decimal amount, string fromCurrency, string toCurrency, DateTime? date, CancellationToken cancellationToken) { if (fromCurrency == toCurrency) return amount; var rate = date.HasValue ? await GetHistoricalRateAsync("USD", toCurrency, date.Value, cancellationToken) : await GetCurrentRateAsync("USD", toCurrency, cancellationToken); // If fromCurrency is not USD, need to convert via USD if (fromCurrency != "USD") { var fromRate = date.HasValue ? await GetHistoricalRateAsync("USD", fromCurrency, date.Value, cancellationToken) : await GetCurrentRateAsync("USD", fromCurrency, cancellationToken); return amount / fromRate.Rate * rate; } return amount * rate; } } ``` ### Commands ```csharp // Configure currency public record EnableCurrencyCommand(string CurrencyCode) : IRequest<Result>; public record DisableCurrencyCommand(string CurrencyCode) : IRequest<Result>; public record SetBaseCurrencyCommand(string CurrencyCode) : IRequest<Result>; // Sync FX rates public record SyncExchangeRatesCommand(ExchangeRateSource Source) : IRequest<Result<int>>; // Returns count synced public record SetManualExchangeRateCommand(string BaseCurrency, string TargetCurrency, decimal Rate) : IRequest<Result>; // Localized pricing public record SetLocalizedPriceCommand(Guid PlanId, string CurrencyCode, decimal LocalizedPrice, bool IsManualOverride) : IRequest<Result>; public record RecalculateLocalizedPricesCommand(Guid? PlanId = null) : IRequest<Result<int>>; // Recalc all or specific plan ``` ### Queries ```csharp public record GetEnabledCurrenciesQuery : IRequest<Result<List<CurrencyConfiguration>>>; public record GetCurrentExchangeRateQuery(string BaseCurrency, string TargetCurrency) : IRequest<Result<decimal>>; public record GetExchangeRateHistoryQuery(string BaseCurrency, string TargetCurrency, DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate) : IRequest<Result<List<ExchangeRate>>>; public record GetLocalizedPriceQuery(Guid PlanId, string CurrencyCode) : IRequest<Result<decimal>>; public record GetPlanPricingInAllCurrenciesQuery(Guid PlanId) : IRequest<Result<Dictionary<string, decimal>>>; public record ConvertAmountQuery(decimal Amount, string FromCurrency, string ToCurrency, DateTime? Date = null) : IRequest<Result<decimal>>; ``` ### REST API Endpoints ```csharp // GET /api/currencies - List all enabled currencies // POST /api/currencies/{code}/enable - Enable currency // POST /api/currencies/{code}/disable - Disable currency // PUT /api/currencies/base - Set base currency for accounting // GET /api/exchange-rates/current?base=USD&target=EUR - Get current rate // GET /api/exchange-rates/history?base=USD&target=EUR&start=2025-01-01&end=2025-12-31 - Historical rates // POST /api/exchange-rates/sync - Trigger FX rate sync from provider // POST /api/exchange-rates/manual - Set manual override rate // GET /api/plans/{planId}/pricing/{currency} - Get localized price // GET /api/plans/{planId}/pricing/all - Get prices in all currencies // PUT /api/plans/{planId}/pricing/{currency} - Set manual localized price // POST /api/plans/{planId}/pricing/recalculate - Recalculate auto prices // POST /api/currency/convert - Convert amount between currencies ``` ### Background Jobs ```csharp // Daily FX Rate Sync (runs at 00:00 UTC) public class DailyExchangeRateSyncJob : IJob { public async Task Execute(IJobExecutionContext context) { await _mediator.Send(new SyncExchangeRatesCommand(ExchangeRateSource.OpenExchangeRates)); await _mediator.Send(new RecalculateLocalizedPricesCommand()); // Update auto-calculated prices } } // Weekly Price Localization Audit (detect stale overrides) public class PriceLocalizationAuditJob : IJob { public async Task Execute(IJobExecutionContext context) { // Find manual overrides that differ significantly from auto-calculated prices // Alert admins to review pricing strategies } } ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Currency Management - [ ] Support 150+ currencies (ISO 4217 standard) - [ ] Enable/disable currencies via admin console - [ ] Set one base currency for accounting (typically USD) - [ ] Configure decimal places per currency (0 for JPY, 2 for USD, 3 for KWD) - [ ] Display currency symbols and names correctly - [ ] Validate currency codes against ISO 4217 standard - [ ] Prevent disabling base currency - [ ] Warn when disabling currency with active subscriptions ### Exchange Rate Synchronization - [ ] Integrate with Open Exchange Rates API (primary provider) - [ ] Support European Central Bank (ECB) as fallback provider - [ ] Sync FX rates daily at 00:00 UTC automatically - [ ] Store historical rates with effective dates - [ ] Manual override capability for specific rates - [ ] Audit log showing rate changes over time - [ ] Cache current rates in Redis for 1 hour - [ ] Retry failed sync attempts with exponential backoff - [ ] Alert admins on 3 consecutive sync failures - [ ] Store raw API responses for audit trail ### Price Localization - [ ] Auto-calculate prices in all enabled currencies using current FX rates - [ ] Support manual price overrides per market (psychological pricing) - [ ] Display override vs auto-calculated price in admin UI - [ ] Recalculate auto prices when FX rates update - [ ] Preserve manual overrides during recalculation - [ ] Effective date support for future price changes - [ ] Expiry date for temporary price overrides - [ ] Bulk recalculation with progress tracking - [ ] Preview price changes before applying - [ ] Rollback capability for price updates ### Currency Conversion - [ ] Convert amounts between any two enabled currencies - [ ] Use current rates for real-time conversions - [ ] Use historical rates for past date conversions - [ ] Support conversions via base currency (USD) when direct pair unavailable - [ ] Round amounts according to currency decimal rules - [ ] Handle edge cases (same currency returns original amount) - [ ] Performance: < 50ms for conversion with cached rates - [ ] Batch conversion for multiple amounts ### User Experience - [ ] Detect user location (IP geolocation) and suggest local currency - [ ] Allow users to select preferred currency in account settings - [ ] Display prices in selected currency throughout platform - [ ] Show original price + conversion on checkout (transparency) - [ ] Update currency selection without page reload - [ ] Remember currency preference across sessions - [ ] Display currency indicator in navigation bar - [ ] Mobile-responsive currency selector ### Billing Integration - [ ] Charge customers in selected currency via Stripe multi-currency - [ ] Store transaction currency on invoices and payments - [ ] Support refunds in original transaction currency - [ ] Handle currency conversion for usage-based billing - [ ] Display multi-currency revenue in admin dashboard - [ ] Export multi-currency financial reports - [ ] Reconcile multi-currency payments to base currency for accounting ### Reporting & Analytics - [ ] Revenue report by currency (show totals per currency) - [ ] Revenue report in base currency (converted amounts) - [ ] Exchange rate variance report (actual vs expected rates) - [ ] Most popular currencies by transaction volume - [ ] Currency conversion costs analysis - [ ] Export reports in CSV/Excel with currency columns ### Security & Compliance - [ ] Encrypt API keys for FX rate providers - [ ] Audit log for all currency configuration changes - [ ] Audit log for manual rate overrides - [ ] Rate limit API calls to FX providers - [ ] Validate rate reasonableness (detect anomalies > 10% daily change) - [ ] Comply with PCI DSS for storing currency data - [ ] GDPR compliance for location-based currency detection ## Impact & Benefits **Business Impact:** - **Global Expansion:** Unlock international markets with local currency support - **Conversion Rate:** 10-30% increase when customers see local prices - **Reduced Cart Abandonment:** Eliminate foreign currency confusion - **Competitive Advantage:** Match capabilities of global SaaS leaders - **Revenue Growth:** Expand addressable market to 150+ countries **Customer Benefits:** - **Familiar Pricing:** See prices in local currency immediately - **No Math Required:** Automatic conversion eliminates confusion - **Avoid Forex Fees:** Pay in local currency reduces card fees - **Price Transparency:** Clear understanding of costs - **Localized Experience:** Platform feels tailored to their market **Operational Benefits:** - **Automated FX Management:** Daily sync eliminates manual updates - **Accurate Accounting:** Historical rates ensure correct revenue recognition - **Compliance Ready:** Audit trail for tax and regulatory requirements - **Reduced Support:** Fewer questions about currency and pricing - **Market Flexibility:** Easy to adjust pricing strategies per region ## Context & Examples ### Example 1: US SaaS Selling to European Customer ``` Plan: Professional $99/month USD (base currency) Customer Location: Germany Selected Currency: EUR FX Rate: 1 USD = 0.85 EUR Auto-Calculated Price: €84.15/month Manual Override: €89/month (psychological pricing €89 vs €84.15) Display to Customer: €89/month Charge in Stripe: €89 EUR Revenue in Base Currency: $104.71 USD (using rate at transaction time) ``` ### Example 2: Multi-Currency Revenue Report ```json { "period": "2025-Q1", "revenue_by_currency": [ { "currency": "USD", "amount": 125000.00, "transactions": 450 }, { "currency": "EUR", "amount": 85000.00, "transactions": 320 }, { "currency": "GBP", "amount": 42000.00, "transactions": 180 }, { "currency": "JPY", "amount": 8500000, "transactions": 95 } ], "total_in_base_currency": { "currency": "USD", "amount": 282540.00, "conversion_date": "2025-03-31" } } ``` ### Example 3: FX Rate Sync Response ```json { "sync_id": "sync_abc123", "source": "OpenExchangeRates", "timestamp": "2025-10-02T00:00:00Z", "base_currency": "USD", "rates_synced": 165, "rates": { "EUR": 0.85, "GBP": 0.73, "JPY": 110.50, "CAD": 1.25, "AUD": 1.35 }, "failed_currencies": [], "next_sync": "2025-10-03T00:00:00Z" } ``` ### Example 4: Currency-Specific Rounding Rules ``` USD: $99.99 (2 decimals) EUR: €84.99 (2 decimals) JPY: ¥11,000 (0 decimals - no cents) KWD: 28.950 KD (3 decimals) ``` ## Technical Requirements ### Database Schema ```sql CREATE TABLE CurrencyConfigurations ( Id UUID PRIMARY KEY, CurrencyCode VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL UNIQUE, DisplayName VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, Symbol VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, DecimalPlaces INT NOT NULL, IsEnabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, IsBaseCurrency BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, DisplayOrder INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, EnabledAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, DisabledAt TIMESTAMP NULL, CreatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() ); CREATE TABLE ExchangeRates ( Id UUID PRIMARY KEY, BaseCurrency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, TargetCurrency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, Rate DECIMAL(18, 8) NOT NULL, EffectiveDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, Source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, Provider VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, RawResponse TEXT NOT NULL, CreatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), INDEX idx_currency_pair_date (BaseCurrency, TargetCurrency, EffectiveDate DESC) ); CREATE TABLE PriceLocalizations ( Id UUID PRIMARY KEY, PlanId UUID NOT NULL, CurrencyCode VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, LocalizedPrice DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, IsAutoCalculated BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, LastCalculatedAt TIMESTAMP NULL, ExchangeRateUsed DECIMAL(18, 8) NULL, EffectiveDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, ExpiryDate TIMESTAMP NULL, CreatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UpdatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE (PlanId, CurrencyCode, EffectiveDate), FOREIGN KEY (PlanId) REFERENCES Plans(Id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); ``` ### Background Jobs - **Daily FX Sync:** 00:00 UTC, sync rates from primary provider - **Hourly Cache Refresh:** Refresh Redis cache with latest rates - **Weekly Audit:** Check for stale manual overrides, alert admins - **Monthly Report:** Generate multi-currency revenue summary ### Integration Points - **Billing Module:** Use localized prices for plan display and subscription creation - **Payments Module:** Process charges in customer's selected currency - **Invoices Module:** Display amounts in transaction currency with base currency reference - **Subscriptions Module:** Store subscription currency, handle currency on renewals - **Reporting Module:** Aggregate revenue across currencies with base currency totals ### External Dependencies - **Open Exchange Rates API:** Primary FX rate provider (https://openexchangerates.org/) - **European Central Bank API:** Fallback provider - **Stripe Multi-Currency:** Payment processing in 135+ currencies - **IP Geolocation Service:** Detect user location for currency suggestion ### Standards Compliance - **ISO 4217:** Currency codes (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY) - **ISO 3166-1 alpha-2:** Country codes for geolocation - **GAAP/IFRS:** Revenue recognition in multiple currencies - **PCI DSS:** Secure storage of currency-related transaction data ## Dependencies - Open Exchange Rates API subscription ($29+/month for 1,000 requests) - Stripe multi-currency account (available on all plans) - Redis caching layer for rate performance - IP geolocation service (MaxMind GeoLite2 or similar) ## Estimated Complexity **VERY HIGH** - Requires FX provider integration, complex currency conversion logic, localized pricing engine, multi-currency reporting, and extensive testing across 150+ currencies with various decimal rules. ## Priority **HIGH** - Critical for international expansion and competitive parity with global SaaS platforms. Blocks entry into non-USD markets. ## Additional Notes - **Testing Strategy:** Use fixed FX rates in test environment to ensure deterministic results - **Rollout Plan:** Beta test with 5 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD) before enabling all 150+ - **Performance:** Cache current rates aggressively, use database for historical lookups - **Monitoring:** Alert on FX sync failures, unusual rate changes (> 10% daily), and conversion errors - **Future Enhancements:** Support cryptocurrency pricing, dynamic pricing based on purchasing power parity, automated hedging strategies for FX risk

acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): # Multi-Gateway Payment Processing ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS platform**, I want to **support multiple payment gateways with automatic failover** so that I can **maximize payment success rates, reduce vendor lock-in, and optimize transaction costs**. ## Problem Statement Relying on a single payment gateway creates risks: - Gateway outages cause revenue loss - Regional gateway performance varies (EU vs US) - Transaction fees differ by gateway and card type - Vendor lock-in limits negotiation power - Different gateways excel at different payment methods A multi-gateway architecture provides: - Automatic failover on gateway downtime - Smart routing based on cost/performance - Geographic optimization - Payment method specialization (cards vs ACH vs wallets) - A/B testing of gateways ## Proposed Solution Implement a multi-gateway payment processing system with intelligent routing: ### Gateway Abstraction ```csharp public interface IPaymentGateway { string GatewayId { get; } string Name { get; } // Payment Method Management Task<Result<PaymentMethodToken>> CreatePaymentMethodAsync( CreatePaymentMethodRequest request); Task<Result> UpdatePaymentMethodAsync( string paymentMethodId, UpdatePaymentMethodRequest request); Task<Result> DeletePaymentMethodAsync(string paymentMethodId); // Payment Processing Task<Result<PaymentResult>> ChargeAsync(ChargeRequest request); Task<Result<PaymentResult>> CaptureAsync(string paymentIntentId); Task<Result<RefundResult>> RefundAsync(RefundRequest request); // Status & Inquiry Task<Result<PaymentStatus>> GetPaymentStatusAsync(string transactionId); Task<Result<PaymentMethod>> GetPaymentMethodAsync(string paymentMethodId); // Webhook Handling Task<Result<WebhookEvent>> ParseWebhookAsync( string payload, IDictionary<string, string> headers); bool ValidateWebhookSignature( string payload, string signature, string secret); } public class StripeGateway : IPaymentGateway { public string GatewayId => "stripe"; public string Name => "Stripe"; // Implementation using Stripe SDK } public class PayPalGateway : IPaymentGateway { public string GatewayId => "paypal"; public string Name => "PayPal"; // Implementation using PayPal SDK } public class AuthorizeNetGateway : IPaymentGateway { public string GatewayId => "authorize-net"; public string Name => "Authorize.Net"; // Implementation using Authorize.Net SDK } ``` ### Gateway Configuration ```csharp public class GatewayConfiguration : EntityBase<Guid> { public string GatewayId { get; set; } public string Name { get; set; } public bool IsEnabled { get; set; } public int Priority { get; set; } // Lower = higher priority // Credentials (encrypted) public string ApiKey { get; set; } public string ApiSecret { get; set; } public string WebhookSecret { get; set; } // Configuration public string Environment { get; set; } // Sandbox, Production public Dictionary<string, string> Settings { get; set; } // Routing Rules public List<string> SupportedCurrencies { get; set; } public List<string> SupportedCountries { get; set; } public List<PaymentMethodType> SupportedPaymentMethods { get; set; } // Performance public decimal? TransactionFeePercentage { get; set; } public decimal? TransactionFeeFixed { get; set; } public decimal? SuccessRate { get; set; } // Calculated metric public int? AverageResponseTimeMs { get; set; } // Limits public decimal? MaxTransactionAmount { get; set; } public decimal? MinTransactionAmount { get; set; } public int? DailyTransactionLimit { get; set; } } ``` ### Smart Routing Engine ```csharp public class PaymentRoutingEngine { public async Task<IPaymentGateway> SelectGatewayAsync( PaymentRoutingContext context) { var eligibleGateways = await GetEligibleGatewaysAsync(context); if (!eligibleGateways.Any()) throw new NoEligibleGatewayException(); // Apply routing strategy return context.RoutingStrategy switch { RoutingStrategy.Priority => eligibleGateways.OrderBy(g => g.Priority).First(), RoutingStrategy.LowestCost => eligibleGateways.OrderBy(g => CalculateCost(g, context)).First(), RoutingStrategy.BestPerformance => eligibleGateways.OrderByDescending(g => g.SuccessRate).First(), RoutingStrategy.Geographic => SelectByGeography(eligibleGateways, context.Country), RoutingStrategy.LoadBalancing => SelectByLoadBalancing(eligibleGateways), _ => eligibleGateways.First() }; } private async Task<List<GatewayConfiguration>> GetEligibleGatewaysAsync( PaymentRoutingContext context) { return await _gatewayRepo.GetAllAsync() .Where(g => g.IsEnabled) .Where(g => g.SupportedCurrencies.Contains(context.Currency)) .Where(g => g.SupportedCountries.Contains(context.Country)) .Where(g => g.SupportedPaymentMethods.Contains(context.PaymentMethodType)) .Where(g => context.Amount >= g.MinTransactionAmount && context.Amount <= g.MaxTransactionAmount) .ToListAsync(); } } public class PaymentRoutingContext { public decimal Amount { get; set; } public string Currency { get; set; } public string Country { get; set; } public PaymentMethodType PaymentMethodType { get; set; } public RoutingStrategy RoutingStrategy { get; set; } public Guid? CustomerId { get; set; } } public enum RoutingStrategy { Priority, // Use highest priority gateway LowestCost, // Minimize transaction fees BestPerformance, // Highest success rate Geographic, // Best for customer region LoadBalancing // Distribute across gateways } ``` ### Failover Logic ```csharp public class PaymentProcessor { private readonly PaymentRoutingEngine _routingEngine; private readonly IEnumerable<IPaymentGateway> _gateways; public async Task<Result<PaymentResult>> ProcessPaymentAsync( PaymentRequest request) { var context = CreateRoutingContext(request); var attemptedGateways = new List<string>(); for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) { try { var gateway = await _routingEngine.SelectGatewayAsync(context); if (attemptedGateways.Contains(gateway.GatewayId)) continue; // Already tried this gateway attemptedGateways.Add(gateway.GatewayId); var result = await gateway.ChargeAsync(new ChargeRequest { Amount = request.Amount, Currency = request.Currency, PaymentMethodId = request.PaymentMethodId, Description = request.Description }); if (result.IsSuccess) { await RecordSuccessMetricsAsync(gateway.GatewayId); return result; } if (!result.Error.IsRetriable) return result; await RecordFailureMetricsAsync(gateway.GatewayId, result.Error); } catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Gateway failure on attempt {Attempt}", attempt + 1); if (attempt == 2) throw; } } return Result<PaymentResult>.Failure( "All payment gateways failed after 3 attempts"); } } ``` ### Commands ```csharp // Add Gateway Configuration public record AddGatewayConfigurationCommand( string GatewayId, string Name, string ApiKey, string ApiSecret, string Environment, List<string> SupportedCurrencies, int Priority ) : ICommand<Result<Guid>>; // Update Gateway Configuration public record UpdateGatewayConfigurationCommand( Guid ConfigurationId, bool? IsEnabled = null, int? Priority = null, Dictionary<string, string>? Settings = null ) : ICommand<Result>; // Test Gateway Connection public record TestGatewayConnectionCommand( Guid ConfigurationId ) : ICommand<Result<GatewayHealthDto>>; // Process Payment with Gateway Selection public record ProcessPaymentWithRoutingCommand( Guid TenantId, Guid SubscriptionId, decimal Amount, string Currency, Guid PaymentMethodId, RoutingStrategy RoutingStrategy ) : ICommand<Result<Guid>>; ``` ### Queries ```csharp // List Gateway Configurations public record ListGatewayConfigurationsQuery( bool EnabledOnly = true ) : IQuery<Result<List<GatewayConfigurationDto>>>; // Get Gateway Performance Metrics public record GetGatewayPerformanceMetricsQuery( DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate ) : IQuery<Result<GatewayPerformanceDto>>; // Get Gateway Health Status public record GetGatewayHealthStatusQuery() : IQuery<Result<List<GatewayHealthDto>>>; // Simulate Gateway Selection public record SimulateGatewaySelectionQuery( decimal Amount, string Currency, string Country, RoutingStrategy Strategy ) : IQuery<Result<GatewaySelectionDto>>; ``` ### REST API Endpoints ``` POST /api/payment-gateways - Add gateway configuration GET /api/payment-gateways - List gateway configurations GET /api/payment-gateways/{id} - Get gateway configuration PUT /api/payment-gateways/{id} - Update gateway configuration DELETE /api/payment-gateways/{id} - Remove gateway configuration POST /api/payment-gateways/{id}/test - Test gateway connection GET /api/payment-gateways/health - Get all gateway health status GET /api/payment-gateways/performance - Get performance metrics POST /api/payment-gateways/simulate-routing - Simulate gateway selection POST /api/webhooks/payments/{gateway} - Gateway-specific webhook ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Gateway Management - [ ] Multiple gateways can be configured simultaneously - [ ] Gateway credentials encrypted at rest (AES-256) - [ ] Each gateway can be enabled/disabled independently - [ ] Priority ordering for gateway selection - [ ] Test connection validates API credentials - [ ] Health checks monitor gateway availability ### Gateway Abstraction - [ ] Unified interface for all gateways (IPaymentGateway) - [ ] Gateway-specific error codes mapped to internal taxonomy - [ ] Consistent response format across gateways - [ ] Webhook signature verification per gateway - [ ] Idempotency key handling per gateway ### Smart Routing - [ ] Route by priority (default) - [ ] Route by lowest cost (transaction fees) - [ ] Route by best performance (success rate) - [ ] Route by geography (regional optimization) - [ ] Round-robin load balancing - [ ] Currency support filtering - [ ] Country support filtering - [ ] Payment method type filtering ### Failover Logic - [ ] Automatic retry on retriable failures - [ ] Maximum 3 failover attempts - [ ] Skip already-attempted gateways - [ ] Fallback to next priority gateway - [ ] Circuit breaker pattern (disable failing gateways temporarily) - [ ] Alert on all-gateways-down scenario ### Performance Tracking - [ ] Success rate per gateway (rolling 24h/7d/30d) - [ ] Average response time per gateway - [ ] Transaction volume per gateway - [ ] Error rate by type per gateway - [ ] Cost analysis per gateway - [ ] Geographic performance breakdown ### Supported Gateways - [ ] Stripe (primary) - [ ] PayPal - [ ] Authorize.Net - [ ] Braintree - [ ] Adyen (international) - [ ] Pluggable architecture for new gateways ### Webhook Handling - [ ] Gateway-specific webhook endpoints - [ ] Signature verification per gateway - [ ] Idempotent webhook processing - [ ] Webhook retry from gateways - [ ] Unified event normalization ## Impact & Benefits - **Reliability**: 99.99% uptime with automatic failover - **Cost Optimization**: Route to lowest-cost gateway (5-15% savings) - **Performance**: Regional routing improves success rates by 2-5% - **Flexibility**: Easy to add/remove gateways - **Risk Mitigation**: No single point of failure ## Context & Examples ### Gateway Configuration ```json { "gateways": [ { "gatewayId": "stripe", "name": "Stripe", "isEnabled": true, "priority": 1, "supportedCurrencies": ["USD", "EUR", "GBP"], "supportedCountries": ["US", "GB", "CA", "DE", "FR"], "transactionFeePercentage": 2.9, "transactionFeeFixed": 0.30, "successRate": 0.97 }, { "gatewayId": "paypal", "name": "PayPal", "isEnabled": true, "priority": 2, "supportedCurrencies": ["USD", "EUR"], "transactionFeePercentage": 3.49, "transactionFeeFixed": 0.49, "successRate": 0.94 } ] } ``` ### Routing Decision Flow ``` Request: $100 USD, US customer, Card payment 1. Get eligible gateways: - Stripe: USD ✓, US ✓, Card ✓ - PayPal: USD ✓, US ✓, Card ✓ 2. Apply strategy (LowestCost): - Stripe: $100 * 0.029 + $0.30 = $3.20 - PayPal: $100 * 0.0349 + $0.49 = $3.98 - Winner: Stripe 3. Process payment through Stripe 4. If fails with retriable error, try PayPal ``` ### Performance Dashboard ```json { "period": "last_7_days", "gateways": [ { "gatewayId": "stripe", "transactions": 1247, "successRate": 0.97, "avgResponseTimeMs": 387, "totalVolume": 124700.00, "totalFees": 3876.30 }, { "gatewayId": "paypal", "transactions": 89, "successRate": 0.94, "avgResponseTimeMs": 542, "totalVolume": 8900.00, "totalFees": 354.81 } ] } ``` ## Technical Requirements ### Gateway Implementations - Stripe SDK integration - PayPal REST API integration - Authorize.Net SDK integration - Abstract factory pattern for gateway instantiation - Strategy pattern for routing algorithms ### Database Schema - GatewayConfigurations table with encrypted credentials - GatewayTransactionLogs table for tracking - GatewayPerformanceMetrics table for analytics - Index on (IsEnabled, Priority) for routing queries ### Security - title: Payment Processing with Retry Queue
author: mathrmartins
acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): # Payment Processing with Retry Queue ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS platform**, I want to **process payments with automatic retry logic for failed transactions** so that I can **maximize successful collections and minimize involuntary churn**. ## Problem Statement Payment failures are common in SaaS platforms due to: - Expired credit cards - Insufficient funds - Temporary bank declines - Network issues during processing Without intelligent retry mechanisms: - Revenue is lost unnecessarily - Customers experience service disruptions - Manual intervention required for each failure - High involuntary churn rates Industry data shows that 30-40% of failed payments succeed on retry within 7 days. ## Proposed Solution Implement a robust Payment Processing system with automatic retry queue: ### Payment Entity ```csharp public class Payment : EntityBase<Guid> { public Guid TenantId { get; set; } public Guid SubscriptionId { get; set; } public Guid? InvoiceId { get; set; } // Payment Details public decimal Amount { get; set; } public string Currency { get; set; } public PaymentStatus Status { get; set; } public PaymentType Type { get; set; } // Payment Method public Guid PaymentMethodId { get; set; } public string PaymentMethodType { get; set; } // Card, ACH, PayPal // Gateway Information public string GatewayTransactionId { get; set; } public string Gateway { get; set; } // Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.Net // Retry Logic public int RetryCount { get; set; } public int MaxRetries { get; set; } = 4; public DateTime? NextRetryAt { get; set; } public DateTime? LastRetryAt { get; set; } // Failure Information public string? FailureCode { get; set; } public string? FailureMessage { get; set; } public bool IsRetriable { get; set; } // Metadata public Dictionary<string, string> Metadata { get; set; } public DateTime? ProcessedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? FailedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? RefundedAt { get; set; } // Navigation public Tenant Tenant { get; set; } public Subscription Subscription { get; set; } public Invoice Invoice { get; set; } public PaymentMethod PaymentMethod { get; set; } public ICollection<PaymentRetryAttempt> RetryAttempts { get; set; } } public enum PaymentStatus { Pending, Processing, Succeeded, Failed, Canceled, Refunded, PartiallyRefunded, RequiresAction // 3DS authentication needed } public enum PaymentType { Subscription, OneTime, Refund, Adjustment } public class PaymentRetryAttempt : EntityBase<Guid> { public Guid PaymentId { get; set; } public int AttemptNumber { get; set; } public DateTime AttemptedAt { get; set; } public PaymentStatus Result { get; set; } public string? FailureCode { get; set; } public string? FailureMessage { get; set; } public string? GatewayTransactionId { get; set; } public Payment Payment { get; set; } } ``` ### Commands ```csharp // Process Payment public record ProcessPaymentCommand( Guid TenantId, Guid SubscriptionId, decimal Amount, string Currency, Guid PaymentMethodId ) : ICommand<Result<Guid>>; // Retry Failed Payment public record RetryFailedPaymentCommand( Guid PaymentId ) : ICommand<Result<PaymentStatus>>; // Process Payment Retry Queue (Background Job) public record ProcessPaymentRetryQueueCommand() : ICommand<Result<PaymentRetryQueueResult>>; // Cancel Payment public record CancelPaymentCommand( Guid PaymentId, string Reason ) : ICommand<Result>; // Refund Payment public record RefundPaymentCommand( Guid PaymentId, decimal? Amount = null, // null = full refund string Reason ) : ICommand<Result>; // Handle Payment Webhook public record HandlePaymentWebhookCommand( string Gateway, string EventType, Dictionary<string, object> Payload ) : ICommand<Result>; ``` ### Queries ```csharp // Get Payment public record GetPaymentQuery( Guid PaymentId ) : IQuery<Result<PaymentDto>>; // List Tenant Payments public record ListTenantPaymentsQuery( Guid TenantId, PaymentStatus? Status = null, DateTime? StartDate = null, DateTime? EndDate = null, int Page = 1, int PageSize = 50 ) : IQuery<Result<PagedResult<PaymentDto>>>; // List Failed Payments public record ListFailedPaymentsQuery( bool RetriableOnly = true ) : IQuery<Result<List<PaymentDto>>>; // Get Payment Retry Attempts public record GetPaymentRetryAttemptsQuery( Guid PaymentId ) : IQuery<Result<List<PaymentRetryAttemptDto>>>; // Get Payment Statistics public record GetPaymentStatisticsQuery( DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate ) : IQuery<Result<PaymentStatisticsDto>>; ``` ### Payment Retry Strategy ```csharp public class PaymentRetryStrategy { // Smart retry schedule based on failure type public static Dictionary<string, int[]> RetrySchedules = new() { // Days to wait between retries ["card_declined"] = new[] { 1, 3, 5, 7 }, ["insufficient_funds"] = new[] { 3, 7, 14 }, ["expired_card"] = new[] { 0 }, // No retry, card must be updated ["do_not_honor"] = new[] { 1, 7 }, ["processing_error"] = new[] { 0, 1, 2, 3 }, ["default"] = new[] { 1, 3, 7, 14 } }; public static DateTime CalculateNextRetry( string failureCode, int currentRetryCount) { var schedule = RetrySchedules.ContainsKey(failureCode) ? RetrySchedules[failureCode] : RetrySchedules["default"]; if (currentRetryCount >= schedule.Length) return DateTime.MaxValue; // No more retries return DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(schedule[currentRetryCount]); } } ``` ### REST API Endpoints ``` POST /api/payments - Process payment GET /api/payments/{id} - Get payment GET /api/payments/tenant/{tenantId} - List tenant payments GET /api/payments/{id}/retry-attempts - Get retry attempts POST /api/payments/{id}/retry - Manual retry POST /api/payments/{id}/cancel - Cancel payment POST /api/payments/{id}/refund - Refund payment GET /api/payments/failed - List failed payments (admin) GET /api/payments/statistics - Payment statistics (admin) POST /api/webhooks/payments/{gateway} - Payment gateway webhook ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Payment Processing - [ ] Payments processed through configured gateway (Stripe primary) - [ ] Payment status updated in real-time via webhooks - [ ] Idempotency keys prevent duplicate charges - [ ] 3D Secure (3DS) authentication handled for European cards - [ ] Payment amount and currency validated before processing - [ ] Transaction ID stored for reconciliation - [ ] Payment receipts generated and emailed ### Retry Logic - [ ] Failed payments automatically added to retry queue - [ ] Retry schedule adapts based on failure reason - [ ] Maximum 4 retry attempts per payment (configurable) - [ ] Exponential backoff with jitter to avoid thundering herd - [ ] Retries paused if payment method is updated - [ ] Manual retry option for admins - [ ] Retry queue processed every hour via background job ### Failure Handling - [ ] Failure codes mapped from gateway to internal taxonomy - [ ] Non-retriable failures (expired card, fraud) marked immediately - [ ] Customer notifications sent on first failure - [ ] Payment method update prompt after second failure - [ ] Subscription suspended after final retry failure - [ ] Detailed failure logging for troubleshooting ### Webhook Processing - [ ] Webhook signatures verified for security - [ ] Webhook events processed idempotently - [ ] Payment status updated based on gateway events - [ ] Webhook failures logged and retried by gateway - [ ] Support for payment.succeeded, payment.failed, payment.refunded events ### Refunds - [ ] Full or partial refunds supported - [ ] Refund reason required for compliance - [ ] Refund status tracked separately from payment - [ ] Automatic subscription adjustment on refund - [ ] Refund confirmation email sent to customer ### Reporting & Analytics - [ ] Payment success rate metrics - [ ] Retry effectiveness analytics - [ ] Failure reason distribution - [ ] Revenue recognition timing - [ ] Gateway performance comparison ## Impact & Benefits - **Revenue Recovery**: 30-40% of failed payments succeed on retry - **Reduced Churn**: Automatic retry prevents involuntary cancellations - **Customer Experience**: Seamless payment resolution without manual intervention - **Operational Efficiency**: Automated dunning management - **Financial Accuracy**: Proper revenue recognition and reconciliation ## Context & Examples ### Retry Schedule Example ``` Payment fails with "insufficient_funds" - Attempt 1: Immediate failure (Day 0) - Retry 1: Day 3 → Still insufficient funds - Retry 2: Day 7 (3 days after retry 1) → Success! - Payment marked as Succeeded - Subscription reactivated ``` ### Payment Flow ``` 1. Subscription renewal triggers payment 2. CreatePaymentCommand executed 3. Gateway API called (e.g., Stripe) 4. If success: - Status: Succeeded - Invoice marked as Paid - Receipt emailed 5. If failure: - Status: Failed - FailureCode/Message captured - NextRetryAt calculated - Customer notified 6. Background job processes retry queue hourly 7. RetryFailedPaymentCommand for eligible payments 8. After max retries: - Mark payment as permanently failed - Suspend subscription - Send final notice to customer ``` ### Non-Retriable Failures ```json { "nonRetriableFailureCodes": [ "card_declined_fraud", "expired_card", "incorrect_cvc", "invalid_card_number", "card_not_supported", "do_not_honor" // Sometimes retriable, depends on context ] } ``` ### Webhook Event ```json { "id": "evt_stripe_123", "type": "payment_intent.succeeded", "data": { "object": { "id": "pi_stripe_456", "amount": 4999, "currency": "usd", "status": "succeeded", "metadata": { "paymentId": "guid-here", "subscriptionId": "guid-here" } } } } ``` ## Technical Requirements ### Gateway Integration - Stripe SDK (primary) - Abstract payment gateway interface for multi-gateway support - Webhook endpoint with signature verification - Idempotency key generation and tracking - Error code mapping from gateway to internal codes ### Background Jobs - Payment retry queue processor (hourly) - Failed payment notification job (daily summary) - Payment reconciliation job (nightly) - Stale payment cleanup job (monthly) ### Database Indexes - (Status, NextRetryAt) for retry queue queries - (TenantId, CreatedAt) for payment history - (GatewayTransactionId) for webhook reconciliation - (SubscriptionId, Status) for subscription payments ### Integration Points - **Subscriptions Module**: Trigger renewals, update status - **Invoices Module**: Create invoices, mark as paid - **Notifications Module**: Send payment receipts and failure notices - **Audit Module**: Log all payment events ### Security - PCI DSS compliance (never store raw card data) - Tokenized payment methods only - Webhook signature verification - Encrypted gateway API keys - Audit trail for all financial transactions ### Standards - ISO 4217 currency codes - PCI DSS Level 1 for payment card handling - PSD2 SCA (Strong Customer Authentication) for European payments - RFC 7807 for error responses ## Dependencies - Payment gateway SDK (Stripe) - Background job scheduler (Hangfire/Quartz) - Notifications module for customer communications - Subscriptions module for lifecycle management ## Estimated Complexity **High** - Complex state management, external API integration, financial accuracy critical ## Priority **Critical** - Core revenue collection mechanism ## Labels `billing`, `payments`, `retry-queue`, `dunning`, `revenue`, `critical`

acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): # Plan Management CRUD Operations ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS platform administrator**, I want to **create, read, update, and delete subscription plans** so that I can **manage the different pricing tiers and offerings available to customers**. ## Problem Statement SaaS platforms need flexible plan management capabilities to: - Define multiple subscription tiers (Free, Basic, Pro, Enterprise) - Configure plan features, limits, and pricing - Update plans as business needs evolve - Deprecate or archive old plans without breaking existing subscriptions - Maintain version history for compliance and auditing Without comprehensive plan management, the platform cannot effectively monetize services or adapt to market changes. ## Proposed Solution Implement a complete Plan Management system with CRUD operations: ### Plan Entity ```csharp public class Plan : EntityBase<Guid> { public string Name { get; set; } // "Professional" public string Slug { get; set; } // "professional" public string Description { get; set; } public PlanType Type { get; set; } // Free, Paid, Trial, Enterprise public PlanStatus Status { get; set; } public bool IsPublic { get; set; } public bool AllowSelfSignup { get; set; } // Navigation public ICollection<PlanFeature> PlanFeatures { get; set; } public ICollection<Subscription> Subscriptions { get; set; } } public enum PlanType { Free, Paid, Trial, Enterprise, Custom } public enum PlanStatus { Active, Deprecated, Archived } ``` ### Commands ```csharp // Create Plan public record CreatePlanCommand( string Name, string Description, PlanType Type, decimal MonthlyPrice, decimal AnnualPrice, Dictionary<string, object> Features, Dictionary<string, int> Limits, int TrialDurationDays ) : ICommand<Result<Guid>>; // Update Plan public record UpdatePlanCommand( Guid PlanId, string? Create new plan GET /api/billing/plans - List active plans (public) GET /api/billing/plans/{id} - Get plan by ID GET /api/billing/plans/slug/{slug} - Get plan by slug PUT /api/billing/plans/{id} - Update plan DELETE /api/billing/plans/{id} - [ ] Plan slugs are automatically generated and validated for uniqueness - [ ] Soft delete preserves plan data for historical subscriptions - [ ] Public API only returns active, public plans - [ ] Admin API can list all plans including archived ones - [ ] Plan comparison API returns feature matrix for multiple plans - [ ] Currency codes validated against ISO 4217 standard - [ ] Annual pricing can include automatic discount calculation ### Data Validation - [ ] Plan name required, 3-100 characters - [ ] Prices must be non-negative decimal values - [ ] Currency must be valid ISO 4217 code (USD, EUR, GBP, etc.) - [ ] Features and limits stored as JSON with schema validation -
