acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **billing system**, I want to **calculate accurate prices with complex discount stacking, proration rules, and tax computation** so that **customers see correct charges and the system maintains pricing integrity across all billing scenarios**. ## Problem Statement Pricing in SaaS platforms involves complex calculations: - Base plan prices with tiered usage - Multiple discount types (percentage, fixed amount, credits) - Discount stacking rules (which discounts combine?) - Proration for mid-cycle changes - Tax/VAT application - Currency conversion - Trial period handling - Addon pricing - Volume discounts - Minimum commitments Without a centralized pricing engine: - **Calculation Inconsistency:** Different endpoints compute prices differently - **Rounding Errors:** Accumulated errors from distributed calculations - **Discount Conflicts:** No rules for which discounts can stack - **Audit Trail Missing:** Can't explain how final price was calculated - **Testing Difficulty:** Can't validate pricing logic in isolation - **Performance Issues:** Repeated calculations instead of caching - **Compliance Risk:** Incorrect tax calculations or proration ## Proposed Solution ### Price Calculation Request/Response ```csharp public class PriceCalculationRequest { public Guid? PlanId { get; set; } public Guid? UserId { get; set; } public Guid? TenantId { get; set; } public decimal? BaseAmount { get; set; } // For custom amounts public string Currency { get; set; } = "USD"; public DateTime? EffectiveDate { get; set; } public BillingInterval? BillingInterval { get; set; } public List<string> PromoCodes { get; set; } = new(); public List<Guid> AddonIds { get; set; } = new(); public Dictionary<string, decimal> UsageQuantities { get; set; } = new(); // For usage-based billing public ProrationType? Proration { get; set; } public DateTime? ProrationStartDate { get; set; } public DateTime? ProrationEndDate { get; set; } public TaxCalculationInfo TaxInfo { get; set; } public bool IncludeTax { get; set; } = true; public bool ApplyCredits { get; set; } = true; public decimal? MaxCreditUsage { get; set; } } public class PriceCalculationResult { public Guid CalculationId { get; set; } public DateTime CalculatedAt { get; set; } public string Currency { get; set; } // Base pricing public decimal BasePlanPrice { get; set; } public decimal AddonsTotal { get; set; } public decimal UsageCharges { get; set; } public decimal Subtotal { get; set; } // Discounts public List<AppliedDiscount> AppliedDiscounts { get; set; } = new(); public decimal TotalDiscounts { get; set; } public decimal SubtotalAfterDiscounts { get; set; } // Proration public ProrationDetails Proration { get; set; } public decimal ProrationAdjustment { get; set; } // Tax public TaxCalculationResult Tax { get; set; } public decimal TaxAmount { get; set; } // Credits public CreditApplicationResult Credits { get; set; } public decimal CreditsApplied { get; set; } // Final public decimal Total { get; set; } public decimal AmountDue { get; set; } // Total - Credits // Breakdown for display public List<PriceLineItem> LineItems { get; set; } = new(); public string CalculationExplanation { get; set; } } public class AppliedDiscount { public Guid DiscountId { get; set; } public string Code { get; set; } public string Name { get; set; } public DiscountType Type { get; set; } // Percentage, FixedAmount, Credits public decimal Value { get; set; } // 20 for 20% off, or $20 for fixed public decimal AmountDiscounted { get; set; } public decimal AppliedTo { get; set; } // Subtotal before this discount public int Priority { get; set; } public bool IsStackable { get; set; } public List<string> AppliesTo { get; set; } // ["base_plan", "addons", "usage"] } public enum DiscountType { Percentage, // 20% off FixedAmount, // $20 off Credits, // $20 in account credits FreeMonths, // 2 months free TrialExtension // 14 days added to trial } ``` ### IPricingEngine Interface ```csharp public interface IPricingEngine { Task<PriceCalculationResult> CalculatePriceAsync(PriceCalculationRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<decimal> GetPlanPriceAsync(Guid planId, string currency, BillingInterval interval, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<List<AppliedDiscount>> EvaluateDiscountsAsync(decimal subtotal, List<string> promoCodes, Guid? userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<ProrationDetails> CalculateProrationAsync(Guid subscriptionId, Guid newPlanId, DateTime changeDate, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task<PricePreviewResult> PreviewPriceChangeAsync(Guid subscriptionId, Guid newPlanId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); Task ValidatePriceCalculationAsync(Guid calculationId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default); } ``` ### PricingEngine Implementation ```csharp public class PricingEngine : IPricingEngine { private readonly ApplicationDbContext _context; private readonly IDiscountService _discountService; private readonly ITaxCalculationService _taxService; private readonly ICreditService _creditService; private readonly ILogger<PricingEngine> _logger; public async Task<PriceCalculationResult> CalculatePriceAsync( PriceCalculationRequest request, CancellationToken cancellationToken) { var result = new PriceCalculationResult { CalculationId = Guid.NewGuid(), CalculatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow, Currency = request.Currency }; var explanation = new StringBuilder(); // Step 1: Get base plan price if (request.PlanId.HasValue) { var plan = await _context.Plans.FindAsync(request.PlanId.Value); var pricing = await GetPlanPricingAsync(plan, request.Currency, request.BillingInterval ?? BillingInterval.Monthly); result.BasePlanPrice = pricing.Amount; explanation.AppendLine($"Base plan: {plan.Name} = {pricing.Amount:C}"); } else if (request.BaseAmount.HasValue) { result.BasePlanPrice = request.BaseAmount.Value; explanation.AppendLine($"Custom amount = {request.BaseAmount.Value:C}"); } // Step 2: Add addons if (request.AddonIds?.Any() == true) { foreach (var addonId in request.AddonIds) { var addon = await _context.Addons.FindAsync(addonId); var addonPrice = addon.GetPriceForCurrency(request.Currency); result.AddonsTotal += addonPrice; explanation.AppendLine($" + Addon: {addon.Name} = {addonPrice:C}"); } } // Step 3: Calculate usage charges if (request.UsageQuantities?.Any() == true) { foreach (var (metricName, quantity) in request.UsageQuantities) { var metric = await _context.UsageMetrics .FirstOrDefaultAsync(m => m.Name == metricName, cancellationToken); var charge = CalculateTieredUsage(metric, quantity); result.UsageCharges += charge; explanation.AppendLine($" + Usage: {metricName} x {quantity} = {charge:C}"); } } result.Subtotal = result.BasePlanPrice + result.AddonsTotal + result.UsageCharges; explanation.AppendLine($"Subtotal = {result.Subtotal:C}"); // Step 4: Apply discounts (ordered by priority) if (request.PromoCodes?.Any() == true) { var discounts = await EvaluateDiscountsAsync( result.Subtotal, request.PromoCodes, request.UserId, cancellationToken); decimal runningSubtotal = result.Subtotal; foreach (var discount in discounts.OrderBy(d => d.Priority)) { var discountAmount = CalculateDiscountAmount(discount, runningSubtotal); discount.AppliedTo = runningSubtotal; discount.AmountDiscounted = discountAmount; result.AppliedDiscounts.Add(discount); result.TotalDiscounts += discountAmount; runningSubtotal -= discountAmount; explanation.AppendLine($" - Discount: {discount.Code} ({discount.Type}) = -{discountAmount:C}"); // Check if stackable if (!discount.IsStackable) break; } } result.SubtotalAfterDiscounts = result.Subtotal - result.TotalDiscounts; // Step 5: Proration adjustment if (request.Proration.HasValue && request.ProrationStartDate.HasValue && request.ProrationEndDate.HasValue) { var proration = CalculateProration( result.SubtotalAfterDiscounts, request.ProrationStartDate.Value, request.ProrationEndDate.Value, request.BillingInterval ?? BillingInterval.Monthly); result.Proration = proration; result.ProrationAdjustment = proration.Adjustment; explanation.AppendLine($"Proration ({proration.DaysUsed}/{proration.TotalDays} days) = {proration.Adjustment:C}"); } var taxableAmount = result.SubtotalAfterDiscounts + result.ProrationAdjustment; // Step 6: Calculate tax if (request.IncludeTax && request.TaxInfo != null) { var taxResult = await _taxService.CalculateTaxAsync(new TaxCalculationRequest { Amount = taxableAmount, Currency = request.Currency, CountryCode = request.TaxInfo.CountryCode, StateCode = request.TaxInfo.StateCode, PostalCode = request.TaxInfo.PostalCode, TaxId = request.TaxInfo.TaxId, IsBusinessPurchase = request.TaxInfo.IsBusinessPurchase }, cancellationToken); result.Tax = taxResult; result.TaxAmount = taxResult.TaxAmount; explanation.AppendLine($" + Tax ({taxResult.TaxRate * 100:F2}%) = {taxResult.TaxAmount:C}"); } result.Total = taxableAmount + result.TaxAmount; // Step 7: Apply credits if (request.ApplyCredits && request.UserId.HasValue) { var availableCredits = await _creditService.GetAvailableCreditsAsync( request.UserId.Value, request.Currency, cancellationToken); var creditsToApply = Math.Min( availableCredits, request.MaxCreditUsage ?? availableCredits, result.Total ); if (creditsToApply > 0) { result.Credits = new CreditApplicationResult { CreditsAvailable = availableCredits, CreditsApplied = creditsToApply, RemainingCredits = availableCredits - creditsToApply }; result.CreditsApplied = creditsToApply; explanation.AppendLine($" - Credits applied = -{creditsToApply:C}"); } } result.AmountDue = result.Total - result.CreditsApplied; explanation.AppendLine($"Amount Due = {result.AmountDue:C}"); result.CalculationExplanation = explanation.ToString(); // Store calculation for audit trail await StorePriceCalculationAsync(result, request, cancellationToken); return result; } private decimal CalculateTieredUsage(UsageMetric metric, decimal quantity) { decimal total = 0; decimal remaining = quantity; foreach (var tier in metric.Tiers.OrderBy(t => t.StartQuantity)) { if (remaining <= 0) break; var tierQuantity = tier.EndQuantity.HasValue ? Math.Min(remaining, tier.EndQuantity.Value - tier.StartQuantity) : remaining; total += tierQuantity * tier.PricePerUnit; remaining -= tierQuantity; } return total; } private decimal CalculateDiscountAmount(AppliedDiscount discount, decimal appliedTo) { return discount.Type switch { DiscountType.Percentage => appliedTo * (discount.Value / 100m), DiscountType.FixedAmount => Math.Min(discount.Value, appliedTo), DiscountType.Credits => 0, // Credits applied separately _ => 0 }; } private ProrationDetails CalculateProration( decimal amount, DateTime startDate, DateTime endDate, BillingInterval interval) { var totalDays = interval switch { BillingInterval.Monthly => 30, BillingInterval.Yearly => 365, _ => 30 }; var daysUsed = (endDate - startDate).Days; var dailyRate = amount / totalDays; var proratedAmount = dailyRate * daysUsed; return new ProrationDetails { TotalDays = totalDays, DaysUsed = daysUsed, DailyRate = dailyRate, Adjustment = proratedAmount - amount }; } } ``` ### Discount Stacking Rules ```csharp public class DiscountStackingRule { public Guid Id { get; set; } public string Name { get; set; } public int MaxStackableDiscounts { get; set; } = 3; public List<DiscountStackingPolicy> Policies { get; set; } = new(); } public class DiscountStackingPolicy { public string DiscountGroup { get; set; } // "percentage", "fixed", "credits" public bool AllowMultipleFromSameGroup { get; set; } public int Priority { get; set; } public List<string> IncompatibleWith { get; set; } = new(); // Other discount codes } // Example rules: // 1. Only one percentage discount at a time // 2. Percentage discounts apply before fixed amount // 3. Credits can stack with any other discount // 4. Specific promo codes may be mutually exclusive ``` ### Commands ```csharp public record CalculatePriceCommand(PriceCalculationRequest Request) : IRequest<Result<PriceCalculationResult>>; public record PreviewSubscriptionChangeCommand(Guid SubscriptionId, Guid NewPlanId, DateTime? EffectiveDate) : IRequest<Result<PricePreviewResult>>; public record ValidatePriceCalculationCommand(Guid CalculationId) : IRequest<Result<bool>>; public record RecalculateSubscriptionPriceCommand(Guid SubscriptionId) : IRequest<Result<PriceCalculationResult>>; ``` ### Queries ```csharp public record GetPlanPriceQuery(Guid PlanId, string Currency, BillingInterval Interval) : IRequest<Result<decimal>>; public record GetPriceCalculationQuery(Guid CalculationId) : IRequest<Result<PriceCalculationResult>>; public record GetPriceBreakdownQuery(Guid SubscriptionId) : IRequest<Result<PriceCalculationResult>>; public record GetAvailableDiscountsQuery(Guid UserId, Guid PlanId) : IRequest<Result<List<AppliedDiscount>>>; ``` ### REST API Endpoints ```csharp // POST /api/pricing/calculate - Calculate price with all rules // POST /api/pricing/preview - Preview price change before applying // GET /api/pricing/calculations/{id} - Get stored calculation // POST /api/pricing/validate/{id} - Validate calculation accuracy // GET /api/plans/{id}/price?currency=USD&interval=monthly - Get plan price // GET /api/subscriptions/{id}/breakdown - Get current subscription price breakdown ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Core Calculation Engine - [ ] Calculate base plan prices with currency conversion - [ ] Support monthly, yearly, and custom billing intervals - [ ] Handle addon pricing with independent pricing models - [ ] Calculate usage-based charges with tiered pricing - [ ] Sum all components accurately to subtotal - [ ] Round amounts according to currency rules - [ ] Cache calculation results for performance - [ ] Complete calculation in < 100ms (99th percentile) ### Discount Application - [ ] Apply percentage discounts (e.g., 20% off) - [ ] Apply fixed amount discounts (e.g., $20 off) - [ ] Apply credit discounts to account balance - [ ] Order discounts by priority (1-100) - [ ] Respect discount stacking rules - [ ] Prevent incompatible discount combinations - [ ] Apply discounts to specific line items (plan only vs all) - [ ] Calculate discount amount correctly for each type - [ ] Stop stacking at non-stackable discount - [ ] Validate discount eligibility (user, plan, date) ### Proration Logic - [ ] Calculate daily rate for monthly/yearly plans - [ ] Prorate upgrade charges (credit unused time) - [ ] Prorate downgrade charges (refund prorated amount) - [ ] Handle mid-cycle plan changes - [ ] Support partial month calculations - [ ] Round proration amounts consistently - [ ] Generate proration line items for invoice - [ ] Preview proration before applying ### Tax Calculation Integration - [ ] Integrate with tax calculation service - [ ] Apply tax after discounts - [ ] Support tax-inclusive vs tax-exclusive pricing - [ ] Handle B2B reverse charge scenarios - [ ] Store tax calculation details - [ ] Display tax breakdown by jurisdiction - [ ] Respect tax exemption status ### Credit Application - [ ] Check available credit balance - [ ] Apply credits after tax calculation - [ ] Respect maximum credit usage limits - [ ] Update credit balance after application - [ ] Generate credit usage line items - [ ] Handle insufficient credits gracefully - [ ] Support multiple credit types (promo, refund, etc.) ### Price Preview - [ ] Preview price before finalizing - [ ] Show itemized breakdown - [ ] Display effective date of change - [ ] Calculate immediate charge vs next renewal - [ ] Show savings from discounts - [ ] Preview proration adjustments - [ ] Allow customer to confirm or cancel ### Audit Trail - [ ] Store every price calculation - [ ] Record all inputs to calculation - [ ] Save itemized breakdown - [ ] Track discount application - [ ] Log proration details - [ ] Timestamp all calculations - [ ] Link to invoices/payments - [ ] Enable calculation replay for debugging ### Calculation Validation - [ ] Validate totals match line item sums - [ ] Check discount amounts don't exceed subtotal - [ ] Verify tax percentages are reasonable - [ ] Confirm proration doesn't exceed plan price - [ ] Detect rounding error accumulation - [ ] Alert on unusual calculation patterns ## Impact & Benefits **Financial Accuracy:** - Eliminate pricing errors that erode trust - Consistent calculations across all systems - Audit trail for regulatory compliance - Reduce revenue leakage from calculation bugs **Customer Experience:** - Clear price breakdowns build trust - Predictable proration reduces surprise charges - Transparent discount stacking rules - Accurate tax calculations avoid confusion **Operational Efficiency:** - Centralized pricing logic easier to maintain - Testable pricing engine in isolation - Faster price changes without code deploy - Reduced support burden from pricing questions ## Technical Requirements ### Database Schema ```sql CREATE TABLE PriceCalculations ( Id UUID PRIMARY KEY, UserId UUID NULL, SubscriptionId UUID NULL, Currency VARCHAR(3) NOT NULL, BasePlanPrice DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, AddonsTotal DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, UsageCharges DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, Subtotal DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, TotalDiscounts DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, ProrationAdjustment DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, TaxAmount DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, CreditsApplied DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, Total DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, AmountDue DECIMAL(18, 4) NOT NULL, CalculationDetails JSONB NOT NULL, CalculatedAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), INDEX idx_user_calculated (UserId, CalculatedAt DESC) ); ``` ### Performance Requirements - < 100ms calculation latency (99th percentile) - Support 1000+ calculations per second - Cache plan prices for 1 hour - Cache tax rates for 24 hours ## Dependencies - Tax calculation service (existing) - Credit management service (existing) - Discount/promo code service (existing) - Currency exchange service (existing) ## Estimated Complexity **HIGH** - Requires complex calculation logic, discount stacking rules, proration algorithms, comprehensive testing of edge cases, and audit trail management. ## Priority **HIGH** - Foundation for accurate billing, critical for financial integrity and customer trust. ## Additional Notes - **Testing:** Create comprehensive test suite with edge cases (negative amounts, zero prices, extreme discounts) - **Rounding:** Use banker's rounding (round half to even) to minimize accumulation errors - **Idempotency:** Calculations with same inputs should produce identical results - **Caching:** Cache intermediate results (plan prices, tax rates) for performance - **Monitoring:** Alert on unusual calculations (negative totals, excessive discounts, etc.)

acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): # Promo Code & Discount Engine ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS marketing team**, I want to **create and manage promotional codes with flexible discount rules** so that I can **run marketing campaigns, reward customers, and drive conversions**. ## Problem Statement Promotional codes are essential for SaaS growth and customer acquisition: - Marketing campaigns require time-limited discount codes - Referral programs need unique codes per user - Customer support needs recovery/retention codes - Sales teams need enterprise negotiation codes - Different discount types (percentage, fixed amount, free trial extension) - Stacking rules to prevent abuse while allowing legitimate combinations Without a robust promo code system: - Manual discount application is error-prone - Revenue leakage from uncontrolled discounts - Poor customer experience with expired/invalid codes - Inability to track campaign effectiveness - Difficulty preventing promo code abuse ## Proposed Solution Implement a comprehensive Promo Code & Discount Engine: ### PromoCode Entity ```csharp public class PromoCode : EntityBase<Guid> { public string Code { get; set; } // "SUMMER2025" public string Name { get; set; } // "Summer Sale 2025" public string Description { get; set; } // Discount Configuration public DiscountType Type { get; set; } public decimal Value { get; set; } // 20 (for 20% or $20) public string Currency { get; set; } // For fixed amount discounts public decimal? MaxDiscountAmount { get; set; } // Cap for percentage discounts // Validity Period public DateTime StartDate { get; set; } public DateTime? EndDate { get; set; } public bool IsActive { get; set; } // Usage Limits public int? MaxTotalUses { get; set; } public int? MaxUsesPerCustomer { get; set; } public int CurrentUses { get; set; } // Eligibility public List<Guid> EligiblePlanIds { get; set; } public CustomerType? EligibleCustomerType { get; set; } // New, Existing, Churned public decimal? MinimumPurchaseAmount { get; set; } // Behavior public int? FreeTrialExtensionDays { get; set; } public bool ApplyToRenewal { get; set; } public int? DurationMonths { get; set; } // Discount duration // Stacking Rules public bool AllowStacking { get; set; } public List<Guid> StackableWithCodes { get; set; } public int Priority { get; set; } // Higher priority applied first // Metadata public string CampaignId { get; set; } public Dictionary<string, string> Metadata { get; set; } // Navigation public ICollection<PromoCodeUsage> Usages { get; set; } } public class PromoCodeUsage : EntityBase<Guid> { public Guid PromoCodeId { get; set; } public Guid TenantId { get; set; } public Guid UserId { get; set; } public Guid? SubscriptionId { get; set; } public Guid? InvoiceId { get; set; } public DateTime UsedAt { get; set; } public decimal DiscountAmount { get; set; } public string Currency { get; set; } public PromoCode PromoCode { get; set; } public Tenant Tenant { get; set; } public User User { get; set; } } public enum DiscountType { Percentage, // 20% off FixedAmount, // $50 off FreeTrialExtension, // +14 days trial FreeMonths, // 2 months free SetPrice // Override to specific price } public enum CustomerType { New, Existing, Churned, Any } ``` ### Commands ```csharp // Create Promo Code public record CreatePromoCodeCommand( string Code, string Name, DiscountType Type, decimal Value, DateTime StartDate, DateTime? EndDate, int? MaxTotalUses, int? MaxUsesPerCustomer, List<Guid>? EligiblePlanIds = null ) : ICommand<Result<Guid>>; // Update Promo Code public record UpdatePromoCodeCommand( Guid PromoCodeId, string? Name = null, bool? IsActive = null, DateTime? EndDate = null, int? MaxTotalUses = null ) : ICommand<Result>; // Deactivate Promo Code public record DeactivatePromoCodeCommand( Guid PromoCodeId ) : ICommand<Result>; // Validate Promo Code public record ValidatePromoCodeCommand( string Code, Guid TenantId, Guid? PlanId = null, decimal? PurchaseAmount = null ) : ICommand<Result<PromoCodeValidationDto>>; // Apply Promo Code public record ApplyPromoCodeCommand( string Code, Guid TenantId, Guid SubscriptionId, decimal Amount ) : ICommand<Result<AppliedDiscountDto>>; // Generate Bulk Codes public record GenerateBulkPromoCodesCommand( string Prefix, int Count, DiscountType Type, decimal Value, DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate, int MaxUsesPerCustomer = 1 ) : ICommand<Result<List<string>>>; // Returns generated codes ``` ### Queries ```csharp // Get Promo Code by Code public record GetPromoCodeByCodeQuery( string Code ) : IQuery<Result<PromoCodeDto>>; // List Promo Codes public record ListPromoCodesQuery( bool ActiveOnly = true, string? CampaignId = null, int Page = 1, int PageSize = 50 ) : IQuery<Result<PagedResult<PromoCodeDto>>>; // Get Promo Code Usage Statistics public record GetPromoCodeUsageStatsQuery( Guid PromoCodeId ) : IQuery<Result<PromoCodeStatsDto>>; // Get Campaign Performance public record GetCampaignPerformanceQuery( string CampaignId, DateTime? StartDate = null, DateTime? EndDate = null ) : IQuery<Result<CampaignPerformanceDto>>; // Check Code Availability public record CheckCodeAvailabilityQuery( string Code ) : IQuery<Result<bool>>; ``` ### Discount Stacking Engine ```csharp public class DiscountStackingEngine { public DiscountCalculationResult CalculateDiscount( decimal baseAmount, List<PromoCode> promoCodes, DiscountStackingRules rules) { var result = new DiscountCalculationResult { OriginalAmount = baseAmount, FinalAmount = baseAmount }; // Sort by priority var sortedCodes = promoCodes .Where(c => c.IsActive && IsValid(c)) .OrderByDescending(c => c.Priority) .ToList(); // Apply stacking rules var applicableCodes = FilterByStackingRules(sortedCodes, rules); foreach (var code in applicableCodes) { var discount = CalculateSingleDiscount( result.FinalAmount, code); result.AppliedDiscounts.Add(new AppliedDiscount { PromoCodeId = code.Id, Code = code.Code, DiscountAmount = discount, Type = code.Type }); result.FinalAmount -= discount; } result.TotalDiscount = result.OriginalAmount - result.FinalAmount; return result; } } ``` ### REST API Endpoints ``` POST /api/promo-codes - Create promo code GET /api/promo-codes - List promo codes GET /api/promo-codes/{id} - Get promo code PUT /api/promo-codes/{id} - Update promo code POST /api/promo-codes/{id}/deactivate - Deactivate code POST /api/promo-codes/validate - Validate code POST /api/promo-codes/apply - Apply code to subscription POST /api/promo-codes/generate-bulk - Generate bulk codes GET /api/promo-codes/{id}/stats - Get usage statistics GET /api/promo-codes/campaign/{id}/performance - Campaign performance GET /api/promo-codes/check-availability - Check code availability ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Promo Code Creation - [ ] Codes are case-insensitive and normalized to uppercase - [ ] Code format validation (alphanumeric, hyphens allowed) - [ ] Unique code constraint enforced - [ ] Start/end dates with timezone awareness - [ ] Bulk code generation with prefix + random suffix - [ ] Campaign association for tracking ### Discount Types - [ ] Percentage discounts (1-100%) - [ ] Fixed amount discounts in specified currency - [ ] Free trial extensions in days - [ ] Free months (skip billing periods) - [ ] Set price override (final price) - [ ] Maximum discount cap for percentage discounts ### Validation Rules - [ ] Code must be active - [ ] Current date within validity period - [ ] Total usage limit not exceeded - [ ] Per-customer usage limit not exceeded - [ ] Plan eligibility check (if specified) - [ ] Customer type eligibility (new/existing/churned) - [ ] Minimum purchase amount requirement - [ ] Stacking rules compliance ### Stacking Logic - [ ] Single code by default (no stacking) - [ ] Explicit stacking allowed with compatible codes - [ ] Priority-based application order - [ ] Prevent abuse with stacking limits - [ ] Calculate combined discount correctly - [ ] Percentage discounts apply to reduced amount ### Usage Tracking - [ ] Record every code application - [ ] Link to subscription and invoice - [ ] Track discount amount applied - [ ] Prevent replay attacks (idempotency) - [ ] Usage count incremented atomically ### Campaign Analytics - [ ] Total uses per code - [ ] Revenue impact (discount amount given) - [ ] Conversion rate (validations vs applications) - [ ] Customer acquisition cost attribution - [ ] Most popular codes - [ ] Expiring codes report ### Security & Abuse Prevention - [ ] Rate limiting on validation endpoint - [ ] Prevent code farming with CAPTCHAs - [ ] Alert on unusual usage patterns - [ ] Audit log for all promo code operations - [ ] Admin-only code creation/modification ### Integration Points - [ ] Apply during subscription creation - [ ] Apply during plan upgrades - [ ] Apply to invoice generation - [ ] Extend trial period in subscription - [ ] Integrate with pricing calculator ## Impact & Benefits - **Marketing Effectiveness**: Track ROI of promotional campaigns - **Customer Acquisition**: Lower barriers with targeted discounts - **Retention**: Win-back campaigns for churned customers - **Revenue Optimization**: Strategic discounting without erosion - **Competitive Advantage**: Flexible pricing strategies ## Context & Examples ### Example Promo Codes ```json { "summerSale": { "code": "SUMMER2025", "type": "Percentage", "value": 25, "maxDiscountAmount": 100, "startDate": "2025-06-01", "endDate": "2025-08-31", "maxTotalUses": 1000, "maxUsesPerCustomer": 1, "eligibleCustomerType": "New" }, "referral": { "code": "REF-JOHN-ABC123", "type": "FreeMonths", "value": 1, "maxUsesPerCustomer": 1, "applyToRenewal": false, "eligibleCustomerType": "New" }, "enterprise": { "code": "ENTERPRISE500", "type": "FixedAmount", "value": 500, "currency": "USD", "minimumPurchaseAmount": 5000, "eligiblePlanIds": ["enterprise-plan-id"] } } ``` ### Stacking Example ``` Base Price: $100/mo Codes Applied: 1. WELCOME20 (20% off, Priority 100) → $80 2. SUMMER10 (10% off, Priority 50) → $72 3. LOYALTY5 ($5 off, Priority 10) → $67 Total Discount: $33 (33%) Final Price: $67/mo ``` ### Campaign Performance Report ```json { "campaignId": "summer-2025", "totalCodes": 5, "totalUses": 847, "totalRevenue": 42350.00, "totalDiscountGiven": 10587.50, "conversionRate": 0.73, "averageDiscountPerUse": 12.50, "topCodes": [ { "code": "SUMMER25", "uses": 412, "revenue": 20600 } ] } ``` ## Technical Requirements ### Database Schema - PromoCodes table with unique index on Code (case-insensitive) - PromoCodeUsages table with (PromoCodeId, TenantId, UsedAt) index - Composite index on (IsActive, EndDate) for active code queries - Metadata stored as JSON for flexibility ### Validation Logic - Code format: ^[A-Z0-9-]{3,50}$ - Atomic usage count increment with optimistic concurrency - Idempotency check before recording usage - Timezone-aware date comparisons ### Background Jobs - Expired code deactivation job (daily) - Usage statistics aggregation (hourly) - Campaign performance calculation (daily) - Low-usage alert job (weekly) ### Integration Points - **Subscriptions Module**: Apply discount to subscription creation - **Invoices Module**: Add discount line items - **Payments Module**: Calculate final amount with discounts - **Analytics Module**: Campaign performance tracking ### Caching Strategy - Active promo codes cached in Redis (15-minute TTL) - Code validation results cached (5-minute TTL) - Invalidate cache on code updates - Campaign stats cached (1-hour TTL) ### Standards - ISO 4217 for currency codes - RFC 3339 for date/time formats - Case-insensitive code comparison - Atomic operations for usage counting ## Dependencies - Subscriptions module for discount application - Invoices module for discount line items - Payments module for final amount calculation - Background job scheduler (Hangfire/Quartz) ## Estimated Complexity **High** - Complex business rules, stacking logic, abuse prevention ## Priority **Medium-High** - Important for marketing and growth, but not blocking core functionality ## Labels `billing`, `promo-codes`, `discounts`, `marketing`, `campaigns`, `revenue`

acceptance_criteria: Original issue requirements (no separate acceptance checklist): # Refund & Dispute Management ## Request Type Feature Request ## User Story As a **SaaS customer support team**, I want to **manage refunds and payment disputes efficiently** so that I can **maintain customer satisfaction, comply with regulations, and minimize revenue loss**. ## Problem Statement Payment disputes and refund requests are inevitable in SaaS: - Customers request refunds for various reasons (dissatisfaction, accidental charges, bugs) - Credit card chargebacks bypass the business and incur fees - Manual refund processing is error-prone and slow - Partial refunds require complex proration calculations - Dispute evidence collection is time-sensitive - Failed refund attempts frustrate customers A proper refund and dispute system: - Automates refund processing with proper accounting - Tracks dispute lifecycle from initiation to resolution - Collects and submits evidence automatically - Prorates refunds based on usage - Prevents double refunds - Provides clear audit trail ## Proposed Solution Implement a comprehensive Refund & Dispute Management system: ### Refund Entity ```csharp public class Refund : EntityBase<Guid> { public Guid TenantId { get; set; } public Guid PaymentId { get; set; } public Guid? InvoiceId { get; set; } public Guid? SubscriptionId { get; set; } // Refund Details public decimal Amount { get; set; } public decimal OriginalAmount { get; set; } public string Currency { get; set; } public RefundType Type { get; set; } // Status public RefundStatus Status { get; set; } public DateTime RequestedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? ProcessedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? FailedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? CanceledAt { get; set; } // Reason & Notes public RefundReason Reason { get; set; } public string ReasonDetails { get; set; } public string? InternalNotes { get; set; } // Processing public string? GatewayRefundId { get; set; } public string? GatewayName { get; set; } public string? FailureReason { get; set; } public int RetryCount { get; set; } // Approval public bool RequiresApproval { get; set; } public Guid? ApprovedByUserId { get; set; } public DateTime? ApprovedAt { get; set; } public string? ApprovalNotes { get; set; } // Initiated By public Guid RequestedByUserId { get; set; } public bool IsCustomerInitiated { get; set; } // Metadata public Dictionary<string, string> Metadata { get; set; } // Navigation public Tenant Tenant { get; set; } public Payment Payment { get; set; } public Invoice? Invoice { get; set; } public Subscription? Subscription { get; set; } public User RequestedBy { get; set; } public User? ApprovedBy { get; set; } } public enum RefundType { Full, // Full payment refund Partial, // Partial refund Prorated // Calculated proration } public enum RefundStatus { Pending, PendingApproval, Approved, Processing, Succeeded, Failed, Canceled } public enum RefundReason { CustomerRequest, Duplicate, Fraudulent, ServiceNotProvided, ProductDefect, Goodwill, Overpayment, SubscriptionCancellation, Chargeback, Other } ``` ### Dispute Entity ```csharp public class PaymentDispute : EntityBase<Guid> { public Guid TenantId { get; set; } public Guid PaymentId { get; set; } public Guid? SubscriptionId { get; set; } // Dispute Details public decimal DisputedAmount { get; set; } public string Currency { get; set; } public DisputeReason Reason { get; set; } public string ReasonDetails { get; set; } // Status public DisputeStatus Status { get; set; } public DateTime DisputedAt { get; set; } public DateTime? TenantId = null, RefundStatus? Status = null, DateTime? StartDate = null, DateTime? TenantId = null, DisputeStatus? Status = null, DateTime? StartDate = null, DateTime? EndDate = null, int Page = 1, int PageSize = 50 ) : IQuery<Result<PagedResult<DisputeDto>>>; // Get Active Disputes Requiring Action public record GetActiveDisputesQuery( int DaysUntilDeadline = 7 ) : IQuery<Result<List<DisputeDto>>>; // Get Refund Statistics public record GetRefundStatisticsQuery( DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate ) : IQuery<Result<RefundStatisticsDto>>; // Get Dispute Statistics public record GetDisputeStatisticsQuery( DateTime StartDate, DateTime EndDate ) : IQuery<Result<DisputeStatisticsDto>>; ``` ### Refund Processing Service ```csharp public class RefundProcessingService { public async Task<Result> ProcessRefundAsync(Guid refundId) { var refund = await _refundRepo.GetByIdAsync(refundId); if (refund.Status != RefundStatus.Approved) return Result.Failure("Refund not approved"); refund.Status = RefundStatus.Processing; await _refundRepo.UpdateAsync(refund); try { var payment = await _paymentRepo.GetByIdAsync(refund.PaymentId); var gateway = _gatewayFactory.GetGateway(payment.GatewayName); var result = await gateway.RefundAsync(new RefundRequest { TransactionId = payment.GatewayTransactionId, Amount = refund.Amount, Currency = refund.Currency, Reason = refund.Reason.ToString() }); if (result.IsSuccess) { refund.Status = RefundStatus.Succeeded; refund.ProcessedAt = DateTime.UtcNow; refund.GatewayRefundId = result.Value.RefundId; // Credit wallet if applicable if (refund.Type == RefundType.Partial) { await _walletService.AddFundsAsync( refund.TenantId, refund.Amount, TransactionReason.Refund, $"Refund for payment {payment.Id}", refund.Id); } // Update payment payment.RefundedAmount += refund.Amount; payment.Status = payment.RefundedAmount == payment.Amount ? PaymentStatus.Refunded : PaymentStatus.PartiallyRefunded; await _paymentRepo.UpdateAsync(payment); // Send notification await _notificationService.SendRefundSuccessNotificationAsync(refund); return Result.Success(); } else { refund.Status = RefundStatus.Failed; refund.FailedAt = DateTime.UtcNow; refund.FailureReason = result.Error.Message; refund.RetryCount++; await _refundRepo.UpdateAsync(refund); return Result.Failure(result.Error.Message); } } catch (Exception ex) { _logger.LogError(ex, "Refund processing failed for {RefundId}", refundId); refund.Status = RefundStatus.Failed; refund.FailureReason = ex.Message; await _refundRepo.UpdateAsync(refund); throw; } } } ``` ### REST API Endpoints ``` POST /api/refunds - Retry failed refund POST /api/refunds/{id}/cancel - Cancel refund GET /api/refunds/pending-approvals - Get pending approvals GET /api/refunds/statistics - Get refund statistics POST /api/disputes - Create dispute GET /api/disputes - List disputes GET /api/disputes/{id} - Get dispute POST /api/disputes/{id}/evidence - Upload evidence POST /api/disputes/{id}/submit-evidence - Submit evidence to gateway POST /api/disputes/{id}/accept - Accept dispute POST /api/disputes/{id}/resolve - Resolve dispute GET /api/disputes/active - Get active disputes GET /api/disputes/statistics - Get dispute statistics ``` ## Acceptance Criteria ### Refund Management - [ ] Create full refund for entire payment - [ ] Create partial refund with specified amount - [ ] Create prorated refund based on usage - [ ] Validate refund amount <= remaining refundable amount - [ ] Prevent duplicate refunds - [ ] Track refund status lifecycle ### Approval Workflow - [ ] Require approval for refunds > threshold - [ ] Support admin approval - [ ] Approval notes captured - [ ] Email notification to approvers - [ ] Pending approval queue ### Refund Processing - [ ] Process through original payment gateway - [ ] Automatic retry on transient failures (max 3 attempts) - [ ] Update payment status (Refunded/PartiallyRefunded) - [ ] Credit wallet balance for partial refunds - [ ] Send refund confirmation email - [ ] Log refund transaction ### Dispute Management - [ ] Create dispute from gateway webhook - [ ] Track dispute status from gateway - [ ] Calculate respond-by deadline - [ ] Alert team on new disputes - [ ] Reminder emails before deadline ### Evidence Collection - [ ] Upload multiple evidence files - [ ] Support invoice, receipt, communication logs - [ ] Automatic invoice/subscription data collection - [ ] Submit evidence bundle to gateway - [ ] Track submission status ### Dispute Resolution - [ ] Accept dispute and issue refund - [ ] Submit evidence to contest - [ ] Track outcome (Won/Lost) - [ ] Record dispute fees - [ ] Update accounting ### Reporting & Analytics - [ ] Refund rate by period - [ ] Total refunded amount - [ ] Refund reason breakdown - [ ] Dispute rate - [ ] Dispute win/loss ratio - [ ] Average time to resolve ## Impact & Benefits - **Customer Satisfaction**: Fast, transparent refund process - **Revenue Protection**: Effective dispute evidence reduces chargebacks - **Operational Efficiency**: Automated processing saves time - **Compliance**: Proper audit trail for financial regulations - **Cost Savings**: Win disputes, reduce chargeback fees ## Context & Examples ### Refund Approval Workflow ``` 1. Customer requests refund ($50 of $100 charge) 2. Support creates partial refund 3. Amount > $25 threshold → requires approval 4. Manager approves with note "Valid complaint" 5. System processes refund through Stripe 6. $50 credited back to customer's card 7. $50 added to tenant's wallet balance 8. Payment status updated to PartiallyRefunded ``` ### Dispute Evidence Package ```json { "disputeId": "disp-001", "evidence": [ { "type": "invoice", "fileName": "invoice-12345.pdf", "uploadedAt": "2025-01-15T10:00:00Z" }, { "type": "communication", "fileName": "customer-email-thread.pdf", "uploadedAt": "2025-01-15T10:05:00Z" }, { "type": "service_documentation", "fileName": "access-logs.pdf", "uploadedAt": "2025-01-15T10:10:00Z" } ], "submittedAt": "2025-01-15T10:15:00Z" } ``` ## Technical Requirements ### Database Schema - Refunds table with (PaymentId, CreatedAt) index - PaymentDisputes table with (Status, RespondByDate) index - DisputeEvidence table with (DisputeId) index - Foreign keys to Payments, Invoices, Subscriptions ### Background Jobs - Process approved refunds (every 5 minutes) - Retry failed refunds (hourly) - Sync dispute status from gateways (every 15 minutes) - Send dispute deadline reminders (daily) - Collect automated evidence (on dispute creation) ### Integration Points - **Payment Gateway**: Process refunds, sync disputes - **Wallet Module**: Credit wallet on refunds - **Invoices Module**: Update invoice status - **Subscriptions Module**: Handle subscription cancellation refunds - **Notifications Module**: Email notifications ### Standards - ISO 4217 for currency codes - RFC 7807 for error responses - Idempotency for refund operations - Audit log for all refund/dispute operations ## Dependencies - Payment gateway integrations (Stripe, PayPal) - File storage service (for evidence files) - Notification service (email) - Background job scheduler (Hangfire) ## Estimated Complexity **High** - Complex workflows, gateway integrations, evidence management ## Priority **High** - Critical for customer support and financial compliance ## Labels `billing`, `refunds`, `disputes`, `chargebacks`, `customer-support`, `payments`, `compliance`
